- Edit short-form content (Instagram Reels, TikTok,
) in Adobe Premiere Pro and CapCut following provided templates and shot-by-shot briefs

- Edit long-form content (YouTube videos, podcast episodes) per format guides

- Apply hooks, pacing cuts, captions, lower thirds, and safe zones exactly as briefed

- Deliver files formatted and labeled per platform specs (aspect ratios, file naming, caption burn-ins)

- Submit edits within agreed turnaround windows (typically 24–48 hours)

- Accept feedback clearly and apply revisions quickly



---



REQUIREMENTS

- 2+ years of video editing experience (short-form social and/or long-form YouTube/podcast)

- Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro (required) and CapCut (required)

- Strong English reading comprehension — briefs and feedback are in English

- Reliable internet and ability to send/receive large video files

- Comfortable working remotely and asynchronously without constant supervision

- Able to follow a template or style guide precisely and consistently



NICE TO HAVE

- Experience with real estate or business/entrepreneur content

- Familiarity with AI video tools (Kling, Veo 3, HeyGen, ElevenLabs)

- Experience clipping short-form content from long-form interviews or podcasts



---



WHY THIS ROLE

- Every project comes with a detailed brief and reference edits — no guessing what "good" means

- Consistent volume every month — reliable editors move from project-based to retainer

- Specific, actionable feedback — we invest in making editors better over time

- Clear expectations, stable workflows, and a structured global team



---



HOW TO APPLY

Please send the following:



1. Portfolio or reel link — must include at least 5 examples of short-form social content (Reels, TikTok, or YouTube Shorts) and 1 example of long-form content

2. Brief intro (3–5 sentences): who you are, where you're located, your experience, and your availability

3. List of tools you use regularly

4. Your typical turnaround time for a 60–90 second Reel edit from raw footage



Shortlisted candidates will receive a paid test week before any offer is made.

title: Short-Form Video Editor & Social Media Manager (TikTok / IG Reels / FB / YouTube Shorts), Music Artist
description:
I'm a US-based hip-hop/R&B artist looking for a talented short-form video editor and social media manager to grow my presence across TikTok, Instagram Reels,
 Reels, and YouTube Shorts.



You'll be running 3 accounts and posting across 4 platforms: TikTok, Instagram,
, and YouTube Shorts.



I'm also looking for someone with experience in AI video creation tools like Higgsfield. This is strongly preferred. I will cover all credits and subscription costs for AI video tools.



This is a long-term role for the right person, with room for pay raises and performance bonuses as the accounts grow.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Manage 3 accounts across TikTok, Instagram,
, and YouTube Shorts

- Edit and post 3–6 short-form videos per day

- Turn raw footage, music videos, studio sessions, and songs into scroll-stopping clips

- Create AI-generated video content using tools like Higgsfield (credits provided)

- Format and optimize each clip for every platform

- Write captions, pick hashtags, and choose trending sounds/formats

- Stay on top of what's trending in the US right now and adapt it to my content

- Keep a consistent daily posting schedule

- Track what's performing and adjust the content strategy



WHAT I'M LOOKING FOR

- Proven experience editing short-form content (TikTok, Reels, Shorts), REQUIRED

- Strong editing skills: fast cuts, captions/subtitles, beat-synced edits, hooks in the first 2 seconds, transitions, effects

- Experience with AI video creation tools (Higgsfield, Kling, Runway, etc.), STRONGLY PREFERRED

- Experience editing music content, music videos, or working with artists is a big plus

- Strong understanding of American culture, hip-hop/R&B, internet trends, and meme culture

- Experience managing multiple social media accounts and growing engagement

- Reliable, consistent, and able to work independently

- Good English communication

- Top of the pay range is reserved for editors with a strong portfolio of viral or high-performing short-form content



SCHEDULE

- About 2–3 hours per day

- Daily posting (flexible hours, but posts need to go out consistently)



PAY

- $300–$600/month depending on experience and skill level

- Performance bonuses for hitting view/follower milestones

- Raises for consistent, high-quality work

- All AI video tool credits paid for by me



HOW TO APPLY

- Start your application with the word "CLIPS" so I know you read this

- Send links to 3–5 short-form videos you've edited (TikTok/Reels/Shorts)

- Send links to any AI-generated videos you've made and which tools you used

- Send links to any accounts you've managed and the results you got

- Tell me which editing software you use (CapCut, Premiere, After Effects, etc.)

- Tell me one trend going viral in the US right now and how you'd use it for a music artist



Shortlisted applicants will complete a short paid test edit.

title: Video Editor for Health & Wellness Brand (Long-Term Opportunity)
description:
We're looking for a passionate Video Editor to join Laviva Health, a global Functional Medicine brand.



We're ready to start immediately, with the opportunity for a long-term relationship if we're a great fit.



What You'll Edit:



* Short-form and long-form educational videos

* Podcast episodes

* Social media content (shorts, reels)



Our content covers Functional Medicine topics such as gut health, thyroid, adrenal health, hormones, inflammation, chronic health conditions, and overall wellness.



Who We're Looking For:



We're looking for someone who understands that great editing is about more than cutting clips, it's about capturing attention, keeping viewers engaged, and communicating ideas clearly.



You should:



* Have experience editing for health, wellness, or medical brands/creators

* Know how to use relevant medical and health B-roll effectively

* Understand audience psychology and retention

* Be a good listener and observer

* ?Learn from the feedback and critique

* Be patient and detail-oriented

* Have strong human understanding and empathy

* Have a genuine interest in Functional Medicine and health & wellness industry

* Have a relevant portfolio (must)



We'll provide training on our editing principles, brand style, and content approach to help you succeed.



If this sounds like you, we'd love to see your portfolio with proof and hear about your experience. Please share your CV and portfolio with short form and long form videos.



Screening Questions Must be Answered:



1. Where do you see yourself in 3-5 years?

2. What do you believe are the biggest mistakes editors make when working on educational health content?

3. What is the primary objective of a video editor in the health and wellness niche?

title: Senior FP&A / Financial Modeling Analyst
description:
Senior FP&A / Financial Modeling Analyst

Remote – Philippines | Full-Time

About the Role

A growing U.S.-based company is looking for a highly analytical Senior FP&A / Financial Modeling Analyst to support its Finance team.

This role will work closely with senior Finance leadership and will focus heavily on financial modeling, forecasting, profitability analysis, pricing, margins, and management decision support.

This is not a traditional accounting or bookkeeping position. We are looking for someone who can take financial and operational data, build reliable models, identify trends and opportunities, and turn the results into forward-looking analysis that helps management make better business decisions.

Key Responsibilities

- Build and maintain detailed financial models for revenue, gross profit, gross margin, EBITDA, and overall profitability.

- Develop product-level pricing and margin models incorporating selling price, product cost, freight, duties/tariffs, and other landed costs.

- Analyze gross margins against company targets and identify products, customers, or transactions that are below target.

- Develop scenario and sensitivity models to evaluate the impact of changes in:

  - Selling prices

  - Product costs

  - Freight and shipping methods

  - Duties and tariffs

  - Sales volume

  - Product mix

  - Other operating assumptions

- Analyze different shipping and sourcing scenarios and determine their impact on landed cost, gross margin, and profitability.

- Identify pricing opportunities and determine the selling prices required to achieve targeted gross margins.

- Develop models showing the financial impact of pricing increases, purchasing savings, freight savings, and other cost-reduction opportunities.

- Build and maintain EBITDA forecasts and bridge analyses showing the impact of pricing, volume, product mix, gross margin, freight, purchasing savings, and operating expenses.

- Support annual budgeting, monthly forecasting, and longer-term financial planning.

- Perform actual vs. budget and actual vs. forecast analysis and explain the key drivers behind variances.

- Analyze historical financial and operational trends and develop forward-looking projections.

- Work with large datasets from accounting, ERP, sales, inventory, purchasing, and other business systems.

- Develop management dashboards and reports that clearly identify trends, risks, opportunities, and areas requiring management action.

- Perform product, customer, and business-line profitability analysis.

- Work closely with Finance and IT to improve the accuracy, efficiency, and automation of financial analysis and reporting.

- Perform ad hoc financial modeling and analysis requested by senior management.

- Present findings in a clear and concise manner and provide actionable financial insights rather than simply reporting numbers.

Required Qualifications

- Minimum 5 years of experience in FP&A, corporate finance, financial analysis, or financial modeling.

- Demonstrated experience building sophisticated financial models from the ground up.

- Advanced Excel and/or Google Sheets skills.

- Strong understanding of revenue, COGS, gross profit, gross margin, EBITDA, operating expenses, and working capital.

- Strong experience with budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis.

- Experience with pricing, profitability, margin, and scenario/sensitivity analysis.

- Ability to work with large and sometimes complex datasets.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to identify the business drivers behind financial results rather than simply reporting variances.

- Strong attention to detail and ability to independently validate financial information.

- Ability to translate complex financial analysis into clear recommendations for management.

- Comfortable working directly with senior Finance and company leadership.

- Strong written and spoken English.

- Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities and deadlines.

- Ability to work U.S. business hours as required.

Preferred Qualifications

- CPA, CMA, CFA, MBA, or similar professional qualification is a plus but not required.

- Experience with Power BI, Power Query, SQL, or similar business intelligence/data tools.

- Experience with QuickBooks Online, ERP systems, or similar accounting and operational systems.

- Experience working with manufacturing, distribution, wholesale, consumer products, inventory-intensive businesses, or landed-cost analysis.

- Experience analyzing freight, logistics, tariffs, duties, sourcing, or supply-chain costs.

- Experience using AI or other modern analytical tools to improve financial analysis, forecasting, scenario modeling, or reporting.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate should be able to take management questions such as:

“If we change our shipping method, what happens to landed cost and gross margin?”

“What selling price do we need to maintain our target gross margin?”

“Which products or customers are generating margins below our target, and why?”

“If product costs increase or decrease, what pricing changes are required to protect margin?”

“Where are our biggest opportunities to improve profitability?”

“What combination of pricing, margin improvement, sales growth, and cost reductions will allow us to achieve our annual EBITDA target?”

The expectation is not simply to provide numbers, but to build the model, analyze the results, identify the key drivers, and provide management with actionable insights.

Application Requirements

Please submit your resume along with a brief description of your FP&A and financial modeling experience.

In your application, please specifically describe:

- Financial models you have personally built.

- Your experience with pricing and gross-margin analysis.

- Your experience with forecasting and scenario/sensitivity modeling.

- Your experience building EBITDA or profitability forecasts.

- The most advanced Excel or Google Sheets model you have developed.

- Any experience with Power BI, Power Query, SQL, AI, or other analytical tools.

Examples of previous financial models or dashboards may be requested during the interview process. Please do not provide confidential information belonging to a current or former employer.

Shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a practical financial modeling assessment.

title: Social Media Director (Full-Time, Remote)
description:
Job Title: Social Media Director | Managing 2 Accounts for TikTok, Instagram & Paid Ads | Full-Time

About Us

REformered is a pilates fitness and wellness studio located in Lanham, Maryland, USA. At REFORMERED, our mission is to reform body and mind through movement. We're building a brand people follow, trust, find community and buy from, and we're looking for a Social Media Director who will own our social presence and turn it into a real growth engine for followers, customers, and sales.



The Role

You will lead our social media strategy from start to finish: planning the content calendar, turning our raw footage into scroll-stopping content, running paid ads, and tracking what drives followers, leads, and sales.



I will upload raw content to a shared Google Drive. You will tell me what to film each week with a clear shot list, then edit that footage into finished content for every platform. You'll work directly with me, the founder, with a lot of trust and independence.



What You Will Do



Strategy and planning

• Build and manage a monthly content calendar across TikTok and Instagram (Reels, carousels, and static posts)

• Set clear goals and benchmarks for growth, engagement, and sales

• Spot trends, formats, and sounds early and adapt them to our brand



Content creation and publishing

• Turn raw footage from our Google Drive into polished short-form videos, carousels, and graphics

• Write captions, hooks, and calls to action in our brand voice

• Schedule and publish consistently, repurposing content for each platform

• Send a weekly shot list so I always know exactly what to create



Paid ads and growth

• Plan, launch, and manage paid campaigns on Meta (Instagram/Facebook) and TikTok

• Test creatives, audiences, and offers, and optimize for cost per lead and cost per sale

• Recommend how to allocate ad budget (budget amount and final approval stay with me)

• Report on spend, results, and next steps



Community and marketing

• Manage comments, DMs, and mentions to build real relationships with followers

• Bring ideas for promotions, launches, collaborations, and UGC or influencer partnerships

• Use social channels to bring in customers and sales, not just followers



Reporting

• Send a short weekly analytics summary: what worked, what didn't, and what you'll change



What We're Looking For

• 2+ years managing social media for a brand (lifestyle, wellness, beauty, or consumer brands preferred)

• A portfolio of short-form videos you edited yourself

• Hands-on experience running paid ads on Meta and/or TikTok, with results you can show

• Strong copywriting skills and a good eye for consistent visual branding

• Comfortable with CapCut, Canva, Meta Business Suite/Ads Manager, TikTok Ads Manager, and a scheduling tool (Later, Buffer, or similar)

• Self-directed, organized, and responsive. You can work independently and communicate clearly in written English

• Reliable internet and a computer capable of video editing



Schedule

Full-time, [40 hours/week]. Daily or weekly check-ins via Googe Meets/WhatsApp



Pay and Hiring Process

Step 1: Paid trial. Create two short-form videos from sample footage we provide, and submit a brief proposal covering how you would handle our content calendar, content creation and posting across platforms, and paid ad strategy and scheduling. You will be paid $50 USD for the trial, whether or not you are selected (We will have full rights to the content provided).



Step 2: Paid onboarding period. If selected, you will be paid $225 USD per week for the first 4 weeks, paid weekly.



Step 3: Long-term role. If it's a great fit, we will move to a long-term contract with a performance bonus tied to results from your ads and content (we'll agree on the details together).



Payment is made directly to you via PayPal- this payment is including all conversion fees occurred on your end, we can unfortunately not process via Wise or other banking methods. This is an independent contractor position. Access to our accounts will be provided through secure, role-based permissions (Meta Business Manager and similar).



How to Apply

Please send all of the following, or your application will not be reviewed:

1. Start your message with the word [REELS] so I know you read the whole post

2. A link to your portfolio or accounts you've managed

3. 2 to 3 examples of your best short-form video work

4. Any paid ad results you can share (screenshots with spend and results are fine)

5. Your expected monthly rate for a long-term full-time role and your availability to start

6. A few sentences on why you're a fit for this role

We're hiring quickly, so apply today. Thanks!

title: Real Estate Market Research and Site Selection
description:
Real Estate Market Research & Site Selection VA

Part-Time | Remote | $3–$5 USD/hour | Long-Term Growth Opportunity



Hello! I am looking for a reliable, organized, analytical, and tech-savvy Virtual Assistant to help identify future locations for Walnut Center, a wellness business offering non-medical massage and spa-related services.



This is not a traditional property management or general administrative VA role. Your main mission is to research markets, identify suitable properties, verify zoning and business-use potential, communicate with property owners or agents, and bring me a shortlist of qualified locations that are ready for review.



I will train you on our specific business model, ideal customer, property criteria, and decision-making process. I will also provide the real estate software, AI tools, systems, and paid resources needed to do the work.



What You Will Be Doing Your work will generally follow this process:

1. Market Research

You will research cities, towns, and neighborhoods to determine whether they fit our business model.

This may include:

- Local demographics and customer profile

- Existing massage, spa, and wellness competition

- Nearby businesses and traffic generators

- Market demand

- Location characteristics

- Other factors that may affect the success of the business

Competition does not automatically eliminate an area. Some competition can indicate healthy demand. Your job is to research the market and identify opportunities as well as potential concerns.



2. Property Search

Once a market looks promising, you will search for properties that fit the criteria I provide.

This may include:

- Residential-style properties

- Mixed-use properties

- Commercial properties

- Standalone buildings

- Privately owned properties

We may sometimes prefer standalone or privately owned properties instead of large shopping plazas.



3. Zoning and Business-Use Research

For promising areas and properties, you will research:

- Township, city, or county zoning

- Zoning maps

- Permitted uses

- Mixed-use or commercial classifications

- Whether our intended business use appears to be allowed

You are not expected to make legal zoning decisions. If something is unclear, your job is to identify the issue, verify it when possible, and flag it for further review.



4. Owner and Agent Outreach

Once a property appears to fit:

- Identify the owner, landlord, or listing agent

- Confirm whether the property is still available

- Contact the owner or agent

- Ask whether the intended business use would be acceptable

- Gather additional property information

- Coordinate a showing when appropriate

- Record all communication and follow-up



5. Evaluate and Present Opportunities

You will organize the strongest properties and compare them based on the criteria provided.

The goal is to present me with qualified opportunities where much of the front-end work has already been completed.

A property presented for final review should ideally already have information on:

- Market fit

- Competition

- Property details

- Zoning

- Business-use potential

- Availability

- Owner or agent communication

- Important concerns

- Recommended next step

The goal is not to send me as many listings as possible.

The goal is to identify the best locations that actually fit our business model and can move forward quickly.

Typical Day-to-Day Work

A typical day may involve researching a new market, analyzing competitors, checking township zoning websites, searching Zillow or other property platforms, using PropStream to research ownership, updating our property tracker, contacting agents or landlords, following up on active opportunities, and ranking properties for review.

You will also use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, and similar platforms to make research faster and more efficient.

AI should help you analyze and organize information, but you must still verify important facts independently.

Required Skills

You should be strong in:

- Real estate and property research

- Market research and competitive analysis

- Online research

- Critical thinking and business judgment

- Organizing and comparing information

- Google Sheets or Excel

- AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Grok

- Written and spoken English

- Professional phone communication

- Learning new software quickly

- Following through without constant supervision

- Attention to detail

You must be comfortable calling U.S. property owners, landlords, and real estate agents.

Preferred Experience

Experience with any of the following is a strong plus:

- Real estate market research

- Site selection

- Residential or commercial real estate

- Mixed-use properties

- PropStream

- Zillow

- 

- LoopNet

- Crexi

- County GIS systems

- Township or municipal zoning research

- Public property records

- Lead generation

- Skip tracing

- Cold calling

- CRM systems

Experience with massage, spa, wellness, or similar service businesses is also a plus, but not required. I can train you on our specific business model.

What I Care About Most

I am not looking for someone who only knows how to search Zillow and copy information into a spreadsheet.

I am looking for someone who can research, think, compare options, spot problems, ask good questions, and help move an opportunity forward.

When information is unclear or conflicting, I would rather you flag it and investigate than guess.

A good personality also matters. This is a small growing company, and I want someone who communicates well, enjoys working with the team, and is interested in building something long term.

Schedule

Approximately 10–20 hours per week to start.

Some availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours will be required for calls with property owners and real estate agents.

Pay

$3–$5 USD per hour, depending on experience and ability.

This is intended to be a long-term role.

For someone who performs well, shows good judgment, and grows with the company, there is significant opportunity for:

- Increased compensation

- More hours

- Greater responsibility

- Training future team members

- Supervising other VAs

- Moving into a management role as the company expands



How to Apply

Please include the following:

1. A short introduction about yourself

2. Your expected hourly rate

3. Your weekly availability

4. Your real estate or property research experience

5. Your experience with market or competitive analysis

6. Your experience with cold calling, lead generation, or contacting property owners

7. Real estate software you have used

8. AI tools you currently use and how you use them

9. Whether you are interested in a long-term position

Required Scenario Question

Please answer the following:

Imagine I ask you to find a new Walnut Center location in Pennsylvania. Walk me through your process from start to finish.

Explain how you would:

- Determine whether the market fits our business model

- Research competitors and demand

- Research zoning and permitted business use

- Find suitable properties

- Verify the property's information

- Contact the owner or agent

- Confirm potential business use

- Coordinate a showing

- Compare and rank the opportunities

- D
 which properties are ready to present to me

You do not need to know our exact business criteria yet.

I want to understand how you think and approach a problem, not whether you already know our system.

Voice Recording Required

Please also send a 60–90 second voice recording answering:

- Who are you?

- What relevant experience do you have?

- Why does this position interest you?

- How comfortable are you speaking with U.S. property owners and real estate agents?

Applications without a voice recording will not be considered.



Please begin your application with:

WELLNESS PROPERTY

Selected candidates may be invited to complete a short paid research exercise followed by a video interview.

title: Executive Assistant & Business Operations Manager
description:
ABOUT METRIX

Metrix is an Australian tattoo supplies brand serving professional tattoo and PMU artists, studios and retailers. We are looking for an experienced Executive Assistant & Business Operations Manager to support the owners across business and personal administration, take ownership of daily operations and grow into broader operational leadership.



THE OPPORTUNITY

Your purpose is to reduce how much the owners have to remember, chase and organise. You will learn the business, manage competing priorities, solve problems and follow work through to completion. Over time, as you demonstrate sound judgment and results, you will gain greater responsibility for running day-to-day operations.



We value an owner's mindset: care for the brand, commercial awareness, accountability and pride in the quality of your work. You must be comfortable managing up, respectfully challenging unclear priorities and following up with us when decisions are holding things up.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

Executive and personal assistance

- Support both owners with inboxes, calendars, appointments, travel, bookings, research and personal administration.

- Turn conversations,
s and voice notes into clear actions, priorities and deadlines.

- Maintain a shared task system in Notion, track commitments and keep the owners informed about decisions needed and anything at risk.



Business operations and customer service

- Handle routine customer enquiries, order updates, delivery issues, returns and wholesale administration.

- Maintain Shopify product information and coordinate order issues with the fulfilment team.

- Coordinate suppliers, purchase orders, couriers, shipment tracking and logistics; monitor stock-related tasks and follow up on delays.

- Keep documents, procedures and business information organised, and improve recurring processes.

- Coordinate with the bookkeeper and marketing specialists so information and tasks reach the right person.



Outsourcing and project coordination

- Source and assess graphic designers, video editors, content creators, developers and other specialists.

- Turn ideas into clear briefs, deliverables, deadlines and proposed budgets.

- Delegate within agreed authority, manage approved budgets, chase progress and resolve issues.

- Check work against the brief and brand standards, request revisions and see projects through to completion.

- Build a dependable network of contractors and document processes that can be delegated as the business grows.



Everyday tools and communication

- Use Notion, Shopify,
, Slack and Microsoft Office, including Excel.

- Use Canva and relevant Adobe tools for everyday graphics, templates, documents and PDFs.

- Monitor Instagram messages and comments, handle routine enquiries and help schedule approved content.

- Learn new systems quickly and find practical ways to make work more efficient.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Proven experience supporting business owners or senior leaders and coordinating business operations.

- Experience managing contractors or projects from brief to completion.

- Strong written and spoken English, sound judgment and clear communication.

- Excellent attention to detail: you verify names, dates, numbers, links, product information and instructions before work goes out.

- Resourcefulness and initiative: you identify problems early and bring practical recommendations.

- Genuine care for customers, the brand and the commercial outcome of your work.

- Integrity, discretion and responsible handling of confidential information.

- Reliable internet and a suitable remote workspace.



Shopify, customer service and logistics experience are particularly valuable. Please explain your level of experience with the tools listed above; sound judgment and the ability to learn matter more than claiming expertise in every application. Tattoo industry knowledge is helpful, and a willingness to learn our products thoroughly is essential.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Customers receive timely, accurate help. Tasks and projects move forward without repeated reminders. Contractors deliver work that meets the brief. The owners have a clear view of priorities and fewer loose ends to manage. You make practical improvements that save time, reduce errors and help Metrix grow.



HOURS, PAY AND PROGRESSION

Full-time, 40 hours per week, with a flexible, agreed schedule providing overlap with both Melbourne business hours and a major supplier in Europe. You must be available for scheduled supplier calls, timely
 follow-ups and time-sensitive logistics coordination during agreed European business-hour windows. This may involve later hours or a split schedule on agreed days, with the schedule planned within the 40-hour working week. You should be reliably reachable through Slack and
 during your agreed working hours. Please state the working windows you can consistently cover in Philippine time; exact coverage will be agreed before starting, taking seasonal time changes into account.

Starting salary: USD 1,000-1,200 per month, depending on relevant experience and demonstrated capability.

We will hold a performance and salary review after the first 90 days, assessing reliability, accuracy, ownership, communication, successful project delivery and the ability to work independently. Salary increases and greater responsibility will be based on demonstrated results and agreed expectations; an increase is not automatic.



HOW TO APPLY

title: SDR Manager - Remote
description:
The Company



This search is being conducted on behalf of Accordant Capital, a Naperville-based family office and growth investment firm. Accordant was named to reflect the firm's commitment to alignment and partnership with entrepreneurs, emphasizing congruency between the goals of operators and the resources the firm provides. Accordant partners with growth-oriented entrepreneurs and CEOs who are seeking more than capital. The firm provides access to leadership talent, growth expertise, and a proven services playbook that enables founders to focus on what they do best — serving their markets in new and innovative ways. Because Accordant rarely raises outside capital, it can focus entirely on aligning its expertise and investment horizon with the needs of its operating companies.



Accordant has a long history of success in multiple industries. Its largest operating platform is MPHQ, serving the $30 billion healthcare compliance market, including market-leading brands MedPro Waste Disposal, HazPro Waste Disposal, and MP1 Solutions. MPHQ provides a growing suite of innovative services including regulated medical waste disposal, OSHA workplace safety, HIPAA certification, HR compliance training, pharmaceutical waste management, and secure document destruction to over 30,000 clients nationwide.



In addition to MPHQ, Accordant's diverse and growing operating company portfolio includes Mend Strategies, Modern Amenities, AIMS Group, and Break Through Closing — each reflecting the firm's approach of partnering with founders to scale businesses through strategic growth, operational excellence, and talent development.



Position Overview:



The SDR Manager will build MPHQ's outbound sales engine from the ground up — Accordant Capital's healthcare compliance platform — and own the revenue it produces. This manager will recruit and ramp a high-performing team, establish the sales motion, and create the operating discipline required to scale from an initial pilot pod to a 10+ rep organization. This is a net-new logo acquisition role — the focus is winning first-time customers, not expanding or renewing existing accounts."



The ideal candidate has done this before, can bring proven talent, and can demonstrate a track record of turning outbound teams into predictable revenue engines. You are a builder, not a caretaker — someone who has launched an outbound sales function from scratch, recruited high-performing sellers, and built the operating system that turns activity into predictable revenue.



Key Responsibilities:



Build the Program

●	Design and stand up the Company's outbound sales motion from zero — including ICP, targeting, messaging, cadences, qualification, objection handling, technology, QA, reporting, and operating rhythm.

●	Recommend the right team structure and pilot size, backed by data, and define the conditions for scaling to 10+ reps.

●	Build a repeatable full-cycle motion where reps prospect, qualify, handle objections, and close, with clear escalation for larger or more complex deals.

●	Partner with Technical/Data and Marketing on list quality, vertical targeting, lead generation, and sales enablement.

●	Design the SDR incentive and commission structure with HR and Finance and align it to qualified pipeline, closed-won revenue, and company economics.



Build the Team — Hire, Train, Retain

●	Own hiring for the team — define the rep profile, run the interview loop, and maintain a high bar for experienced sellers.

●	Recruit and ramp an initial 5-person pilot pod, then scale based on demonstrated production and unit economics.

●	Tap your own bench and network of proven SDRs, BDRs, inside sales reps, or closers who can accelerate time-to-productivity, subject to the Company's standard hiring process.

●	Build a repeatable onboarding and ramp program that shortens time-to-first-opportunity and time-to-quota.

●	Establish a rigorous coaching rhythm using live calls/recordings, with regular feedback on discovery, active listening, gatekeeper navigation, objection handling, and closing.

●	Own retention and performance management, keeping top producers engaged and accountable.



Own Revenue & Outbound Production

●	Track record of winning net-new, first-time customers (new logos) in a competitive or incumbent-vendor sales cycle — not primarily account expansion or renewal-based selling.

●	Experience closing larger, high-level, or enterprise/multi-stakeholder deals, in addition to high-volume outbound activity.

●	Own team targets for qualified opportunities, net-new customer acquisition, closed revenue, and quota attainment.

●	Build and execute outbound calling cadences into US provider offices — physician, dental, long-term care, veterinary, and other non-acute practices.

●	Ensure reps can position the Company's value on cost savings, compliance coverage, and service reliability, and handle price and incumbent-vendor objections.

●	Personally inspect the sales motion and intervene where activity, conversion, or close rates break down.

Pipeline, Process & Enablement

●	Create and maintain call guides, discovery frameworks, objection-handling guides, and playbooks.

●	Oversee call monitoring and QA to ensure consistent, professional, compliant customer interactions.

●	Use CRM, sales-engagement/sequencing, dialer, call-coaching, and reporting tools to drive transparency and accountability.

●	Monitor pipeline health, stage conversion, time-to-close, and bottlenecks; turn findings into specific process changes.

●	Maintain disciplined CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting.



Performance, Reporting & Unit Economics

●	Track daily, weekly, and monthly KPIs — dials, connects, conversations, qualified opportunities, conversion, closed revenue, and quota attainment.

●	Own the sales funnel from activity through revenue and establish clear baseline conversion metrics.

●	Measure and improve unit economics, including cost per qualified opportunity, cost per acquisition, revenue per rep, and payback.

●	Use performance data to determine when to adjust the people, process, proposition, or investment level before scaling.

●	Provide concise, actionable reporting to US executive leadership and participate in strategic reviews.



Required Qualifications

●	5+ years in B2B outbound and consultative sales with a documented record of quota attainment, including hands-on prospecting and closing.

●	3+ years leading SDR, inside sales, or comparable outbound teams.

●	Required: demonstrated experience building and scaling an outbound sales function from zero — not simply managing an established team.

●	Documented track record with specific, quotable results from a team built and scaled to consistent quota attainment.

●	Personally recruited and ramped sales talent; able to explain the rep profile, sourcing strategy, hiring bar, and time-to-productivity.

●	Existing network or bench of proven sales talent that can be activated for the initial team is strongly preferred.

●	Strong command of CRM, sales engagement/sequencing, dialer, call-recording/coaching, and reporting tools; able to independently build cadences, scripts, QA, and performance reporting. Salesforce experience preferred.

●	Data-driven operator who can diagnose where conversion breaks down and adapt the playbook accordingly.

●	Consultative selling philosophy — leads with discovery, listens before recommending, and can coach this approach rather than simply enforce scripts.

●	Exceptional spoken and written English with a warm, credible phone presence for a US audience.

●	Entrepreneurial mindset and comfort operating in a fast-paced, quota-driven environment.

●	Reliable remote work setup with stable high-speed internet, headset, and backup power/internet; full overlap with US business hours (CST).



Nice-To-Have

Compensation & Benefits

Company as it deems necessary; details will be stated in the employment contract.

title: Remote Sales & Enrollment Rep — Dance Studio (Part Time to Full Time Opportunity)
description:
IF SALES CONVERSATIONS ENERGIZE YOU AND YOU HATE LETTING A LEAD GO COLD, THIS ROLE WAS BUILT FOR YOU.



We are a dance studio that has built something real in our community. What we do goes far beyond teaching dance. We build confidence, friendships, leadership, and skills that stay with people for life. Every family that reaches out to us is already looking for that. Your job is to make sure they find it, and to bring more people into what we are building.



We are hiring one person to own this role. Not manage it. Own it.





WHAT THIS ROLE ACTUALLY IS



This is a part time, remote sales role. The heart of it is outbound and inbound outreach to warm leads, real people who have already expressed interest in the studio. Your job is to be the first voice they hear, build genuine connection quickly, and guide them toward enrollment through real conversations.



When lead flow is strong, you are following up. When there is downtime, you are prospecting, going out and finding new families through social media, community groups, and online platforms. You are not waiting for things to come to you. You are making them happen.



You will also support the studio with weekly
s to leads and occasionally contribute to social media content. These are a small part of the role, but they are consistent and they count.



This role has a real growth path. If you are consistently converting leads and bringing new families into the studio, the hours are there to grow with you. The right person will not stay part time for long.





WHAT YOU WILL DO



- Contact new leads immediately when they come in. Speed is a real advantage in enrollment. First contact almost always wins.



- Follow up with prospective families and adult students through calls, texts, and
s using a structured cadence.



- Manage your pipeline and know where every lead stands at all times. Log your activity and report daily.



- Prospect for new leads during downtime through social media, community groups, and online platforms.



- Write weekly
s to leads and support social media content as needed.



- Show up as a true team player. The studio owner may occasionally bring you into tasks outside your core scope. If it supports the studio's growth, you are in. That flexibility and willingness to contribute is something we value deeply in whoever joins this team.





WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR



These are our priorities, in order:



- Phone presence above everything else. You need to sound calm, natural, and confident on every call. Not scripted. Not stiff. The kind of person who can hold a real conversation, earn trust quickly, and move it forward without forcing anything. If that description fits you, you are already ahead of most applicants.



- Fluent in spoken and written English at a C1 level or higher. This will be assessed.



- Experienced in sales, outreach, appointment setting, or enrollment based roles.



- Organized and reliable. You manage your leads, report your activity, and stay on top of follow ups without needing reminders.



- Self directed and comfortable working independently.



- Energized by conversations and motivated by real results.



- Familiar with CRM tools or lead tracking systems. Helpful but not required.



A background or interest in dance is a nice bonus. It is absolutely not required.





SCHEDULE



- 20 hours per week, spread across 7 days.



- The bulk of your hours fall on weekdays.



- Weekends are light, typically 1 to 3 hours, focused on inbound leads only. No outbound on weekends.



- Hours are scheduled within a window of 8:00 AM to 9:00 PM Pacific Time. Your actual schedule within that window is set with the studio owner and may shift by season. It will always be discussed and agreed on in advance.





TWO WEEK TRIAL PERIOD



The role begins with a 2 week trial period to make sure there is a strong fit on both sides. During this time, we will be looking closely at reliability, communication, follow through, organization, quality of work, and how effectively you manage leads without needing constant direction.



At the end of the 2 weeks, we will review performance together and d
 whether to continue the role long term.





COMPENSATION



$250 per month, paid bi weekly via Wise.



This starts as a part time role. If you are consistently bringing new families into the studio, even a handful a month, there is a genuine path to full time. We want to give more hours to someone who is making the most of the ones they have. Results open doors here.





WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS



Every family that contacts this studio is already hoping for something meaningful. A place where their child grows. A community they can belong to. Your follow up, your voice, your consistency, that is what turns their interest into a yes. The right person in this role does not just fill a position. They change outcomes for real families.





TO APPLY



Send your resume and a short introduction. Tell us about a time you followed up with someone consistently and it made a real difference.



Include "Buzz Lightyear" in your subject line or message title. We read every application that includes it. Think of it as the first small sign that you are someone who reads carefully and follows through, two things that matter a lot in this role.

This role is specifically for someone who has hands-on experience with Shopify and understands how to build, set up, manage, and maintain a Shopify store from scratch.

We are looking for someone who can work independently, solve problems, learn quickly, and take ownership of e-commerce tasks without needing constant supervision.



What You'll Be Doing

Build and set up Shopify stores from scratch

Configure Shopify store settings, navigation, collections, pages, and menus

Create, upload, organize, and update products and product variants

Write and format product titles, descriptions, pricing, SKUs, and other product information

Upload and organize product images and other store content

Set up and manage collections, categories, tags, and product organization

Install, configure, and manage Shopify apps

Assist with Shopify themes, page layouts, and store customization

Manage and update inventory and product availability

Monitor and process orders through Shopify

Assist with order fulfillment, returns, refunds, and customer order concerns

Troubleshoot Shopify store issues and research solutions independently

Test the website to identify broken links, incorrect information, checkout issues, or other problems

Help improve the overall organization and customer experience of the online store

Conduct competitor, product, and e-commerce research

Learn and work with additional e-commerce tools and software as needed

Identify and flag potential problems before they become bigger issues

Provide clear daily updates on completed, ongoing, and pending work

Take on additional e-commerce responsibilities as the business grows



What We're Looking For

Shopify experience is required for this position.



You should have:

Strong hands-on experience using Shopify

Experience creating and setting up a Shopify store from scratch

Experience managing products, variants, collections, inventory, and orders

Experience installing and configuring Shopify apps

Understanding of Shopify themes, navigation, pages, and store structure

Understanding of the e-commerce customer journey from product page through checkout and fulfillment

Ability to troubleshoot Shopify and e-commerce issues independently

Excellent written and spoken English

Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills

Resourcefulness and the ability to research and figure things out independently

Strong attention to detail

Excellent organization and time-management skills

Proactive communication and the ability to work without constant follow-up

Comfort learning new e-commerce software, apps, and technology



Availability for 40 hours per week

Ability to start ASAP



Please do not apply if you have never worked extensively with Shopify. We are looking for someone who can confidently work inside Shopify and build and manage a store from the ground up.



Compensation & Benefits

Approximately $600 USD/month

13th-month pay starting next year

HMO insurance after 6 months - 1 dependent

Full-time, long-term opportunity

Opportunity to take on greater responsibilities as the business expands



How to Apply

Please send all three of the following:

Your updated resume

A 2-minute introduction video using Loom or YouTube

A short written response describing a Shopify or e-commerce problem you encountered and how you solved it



In Your Introduction Video, Briefly Tell Us:

Your name

How many years of Shopify and e-commerce experience you have

Your experience building Shopify stores from scratch

The Shopify tasks you can confidently handle without training

Shopify apps or other e-commerce tools you've worked with

An example of a Shopify or e-commerce problem you've solved

Why you think you'd be a good fit for this position



Applications that do not include all three requirements may not be considered.

title: Remote Home Health Scheduling Coordinator
description:
Remote Home Health Scheduling Coordinator



We are a U.S.-based home care organization seeking an experienced Remote Home Health Scheduling Coordinator to support caregiver scheduling and client service operations.



This is a long-term independent contractor opportunity for someone who is highly organized, dependable and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where schedules and priorities can change quickly.



Prior experience with home health, home care, healthcare staffing or high-volume employee scheduling is strongly preferred.



SCHEDULE & AVAILABILITY

This position primarily supports our team during U.S. Eastern Time (ET) daytime business hours, Monday-Friday.

The position also includes assigned on-call coverage outside normal business hours, which may include varying evening, overnight and weekend hours in U.S. Eastern Time.



On-call coverage may involve responding to caregiver callouts, cancellations, open shifts and other time-sensitive scheduling changes that require timely attention.



Between regular scheduling responsibilities and assigned on-call coverage, candidates should anticipate a total commitment averaging approximately 50-60 hours per week. The exact distribution of hours may vary from week to week based on scheduling needs and on-call activity.



Applicants should carefully consider the time difference between their location and U.S. Eastern Time before applying. Reliable availability during the required U.S. hours and assigned on-call periods is essential.



RESPONSIBILITIES

• Coordinate caregiver schedules based on client needs, caregiver qualifications, availability and continuity of care

• Match caregivers with clients while maintaining schedule consistency and minimizing overtime, cancellations and unnecessary changes

• Respond quickly to caregiver callouts, cancellations, open shifts and last-minute scheduling changes

• Communicate new assignments, schedule changes and important details to caregivers, clients and internal team members

• Maintain accurate caregiver availability, skills and scheduling information within company systems

• Document scheduling activity, calls, changes and follow-up

• Follow up consistently with caregivers regarding availability, assignments and scheduling needs

• Professionally address caregiver and client concerns and assist with resolving scheduling conflicts

• Remain calm and solution-focused when dealing with urgent staffing needs

• Monitor phone,
 and electronic communications throughout assigned working hours and on-call periods

• Coordinate closely with operations, client care and workforce team members

• Assist with caregiver recruiting, interviewing and onboarding coordination when needed

• Participate in assigned on-call coverage

• Maintain strict confidentiality of client, caregiver and company information

• Perform other related administrative and scheduling support as needed



QUALIFICATIONS

• Previous scheduling, staffing or workforce coordination experience

• Home health, home care or healthcare scheduling experience strongly preferred

• Experience managing frequent schedule changes, callouts, open shifts and staffing needs

• Strong spoken and written English

• Excellent telephone and customer service skills

• Strong organization, follow-up and attention to detail

• Ability to multitask and manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment

• Ability to remain calm and professional during urgent or stressful situations

• Strong problem-solving skills and sound judgment

• Comfortable communicating directly with U.S.-based clients, caregivers and management

• Experience with Microsoft Office and cloud-based business systems

• Ability to quickly learn scheduling, CRM and other company software

• Ability to appropriately handle confidential and sensitive information



EQUIPMENT & REMOTE WORK REQUIREMENTS

As an independent contractor, you must provide and maintain your own:

• Reliable computer suitable for daily business use

• Reliable high-speed internet connection

• Backup plan for internet or power interruptions

• Professional and quiet environment for telephone and Zoom communications

• Current operating system and security updates

• Active firewall and reputable antivirus/endpoint security protection

• Secure, password-protected computer that is not shared with unauthorized individuals

Please take the cost of maintaining your equipment, internet, backup connectivity and required computer security into consideration when determining your contractor bid.



CONTRACTOR COMPENSATION

This is an independent contractor opportunity, not a U.S. employee position.

Compensation will be structured as one agreed monthly contractor payment in U.S. dollars (USD).

The monthly contractor payment is intended to cover the complete scope of the engagement, including regular weekday scheduling responsibilities and assigned on-call coverage. There is not a separate hourly rate or separate on-call payment.

Candidates should base their proposed monthly contractor bid on an expected total commitment averaging approximately 50-60 hours per week, including regular responsibilities and assigned on-call coverage.

Please consider the complete scope of the position, schedule requirements, varying on-call hours, availability expectations and your own equipment, internet and security expenses when determining your proposed monthly contractor bid.

Payment is made monthly on Net 30 terms.



PAID TIME AWAY

The contractor arrangement includes 10 paid days off per year, along with paid holidays.

Because this position supports ongoing client and caregiver scheduling, planned time away must be coordinated in advance to ensure appropriate coverage.



TO APPLY

Please apply directly through OnlineJobs.ph and provide the following information with your application:

• Full name

• Current location and time zone

• Summary of your scheduling and staffing experience

• Whether you have previously scheduled caregivers, home health staff, healthcare workers or other shift-based employees

• Experience supporting U.S.-based companies, if applicable

• Confirmation that you can regularly work U.S. Eastern Time daytime hours

• Confirmation that you can participate in assigned evening, overnight, weekend and holiday on-call coverage

• Confirmation that you understand the expected total commitment is approximately 50-60 hours per week, including assigned on-call coverage

• Current computer, internet and backup power/internet setup

• Confirmation that you can meet the computer security requirements outlined above

• Your proposed monthly contractor bid in USD for the complete engagement, including assigned on-call coverage

• Your earliest availability to begin



Applicants must have a verified OnlineJobs.ph ID to be considered.



Please do not contact our employees, affiliated companies or company websites directly regarding your application. All applicant communication should remain through the OnlineJobs.ph hiring process unless you are contacted directly by our hiring team. Direct outreach outside of the application process may disqualify your application from further consideration.



Job Type: Full-Time Independent Contractor

Work Location: Remote

Primary Schedule: Monday-Friday, U.S. Eastern Time daytime hours

Additional Availability: Assigned on-call coverage including varying evenings, overnight hours and weekends

Expected Total Commitment: Approximately 50-60 hours per week, including assigned on-call coverage

title: VI
description:
Virtual Assistant — HVAC Scheduling

Best Heating & Air LLC

Tupelo, MS (remote / virtual)
About the company

Best Heating & Air LLC is a licensed, bonded, and insured HVAC company serving Tupelo, Fulton, and a 30-mile radius. We do residential and commercial repairs, installs, replacements, changeouts, and maintenance plans. This is a virtual role. You will not be in the field or in the shop. You will keep the schedule accurate from wherever you work.

The role

You add jobs to the schedule and keep it clean. Service calls, installs, changeouts, and maintenance visits go into Housecall Pro the way we specify. You confirm details, watch for conflicts, and communicate clearly with the office and technicians. The schedule is the job.

What you will do

•  Add and update jobs in Housecall Pro from the information we send you

•  Confirm customer name, address, phone, job type, and notes before a job is booked

•  Keep the board current when appointments move, run long, or cancel

•  Learn our Blue Collar Cam process and use the app the way we show you, so job notes and documentation match the field

•  Write and speak fluent English so nothing is lost between you, the customer, and the technician

•  Flag missing information or double-bookings before they become same-day problems

•  Follow the written scheduling steps every time; bring a better idea only after the current step is done correctly

What you need

•  Some experience working for an HVAC company, even if it was office, dispatch, or virtual support

•  Familiar with Housecall Pro

•  Willing to learn the Blue Collar Cam app on our process, not your own version of it

•  Fluent in English, spoken and written

•  Able to think outside the box when a day gets messy, without skipping the process

•  Reliable, reachable during agreed hours, and willing to be corrected

•  Set up to work virtually: steady internet, a quiet place to take calls or messages, and a phone or computer you can use for Housecall Pro and Blue Collar Cam

How we work

This is remote, but it is not freelance. Instructions are specific. If a step is written down, it gets done that way. Thinking outside the box is useful when the written process does not cover the situation. Please submit resume and in resume please tell me your favorite color and if u have any children.

title: Medical Billing Coordinator
description:
About the Role



We are looking for a detail-oriented, organized, and highly communicative Cash Pay Billing & Patient Accounts Coordinator to join our team.



This role is primarily focused on cash-pay billing, patient accounts, payment plans, recurring payments, outstanding balances, and direct patient communication.



This is not primarily an insurance claims-processing position. We already have team members handling insurance-related billing. We need someone who can help ensure that the cash-pay side of our practice is handled accurately, consistently, and professionally.



The ideal candidate will have experience in medical billing, patient accounts, healthcare administration, accounting, or a related field. Accounting experience or a CPA background is a plus, particularly for someone comfortable working with accounts receivable, payment records, and financial reconciliation.



Key Responsibilities



•Manage and follow up on cash-pay patient billing.

•Communicate directly with patients regarding balances, payments, and payment arrangements.

•Set up and monitor patient payment plans

•Follow up on outstanding balances and unpaid accounts

•Process and monitor recurring patient payments

•Manage recurring monthly payments related to tissue storage (eggs, sperm, and embryos)

•Review patient cases to identify billing items that may have been missed (insurance and cash cases)

•Prepare a complete list of applicable billing codes and services for the existing medical biller for each treatment case

•Ensure all relevant services are identified and ready for billing

•Coordinate with the existing medical billing team when additional information is needed

•Maintain accurate patient billing and payment records

•Review accounts for accuracy and completeness

•Assist with accounts receivable tracking and follow-up

•Identify discrepancies or missing payment information and communicate them to the appropriate team member

•Handle patient financial information with professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality

•Ensure patients in treatment and returning patients are current before completion or initiation of care



What We Are Looking For



•Experience with cash-pay medical billing, patient accounts, or healthcare billing

•Experience handling patient payment plans and outstanding balances

•Accounting experience or CPA background is a plus

•Understanding of accounts receivable, payment tracking, and financial records

•Strong written and spoken English

•Comfortable communicating directly with patients about financial matters

•Strong attention to detail when reviewing patient cases and billing information

•Ability to identify missing or incomplete billing items

•Strong organizational and follow-up skills

•Professional, respectful, and empathetic communication style

•Ability to work independently and communicate effectively with the team

•Experience with medical billing or healthcare systems is preferred

•Comfortable working with spreadsheets, payment records, and financial information

•Ability to maintain confidentiality when handling patient and financial information



How to Apply



Please provide:

•A brief introduction about yourself

•Resume and portfolio

•Voice recording using Vocaroo (1-minute introduction)

•A brief description of your experience communicating directly with patients about balances or payments

•A brief description of your medical billing, patient accounts, accounting, or CPA experience, if applicable



Please start your application with the words “Medical Billing” to confirm that you have read the full job description.

title: Senior Fulfilment and Last Mile Operations Manager
description:
Remote | Full-time



Make the daily decisions that keep deliveries moving, warehouse capacity under control and transport costs balanced.



We are looking for an experienced fulfilment and last mile operations professional to take ownership of the flow of customer orders from our warehouses through to final delivery.



This is a senior, hands-on role with a strong focus on operational judgement. You’ll work closely with the Fulfillment team lead, our warehouse, customer service and transport partners to make practical decisions that balance customer commitments, available space, delivery capacity and cost.



You’ll need to see the whole picture. Sometimes bringing stock forward protects a customer delivery date. Other times, consolidating a linehaul movement makes better commercial sense, or moving stock sooner is necessary to free up warehouse space and keep orders flowing. Your role is to weigh the trade-offs, make the call and ensure the teams involved follow through.



What you’ll be responsible for:



Daily fulfilment decisions: Set priorities across picking, dispatch, stock transfers and delivery, taking account of order readiness, capacity and customer commitments.



Warehouse capacity and stock flow: Work with warehouse leaders to manage space constraints, inbound arrivals and outbound volumes, preventing congestion and unnecessary handling.



Linehaul planning: Balance transfer timing, load utilization and transport costs against stock availability and warehouse capacity.



Last mile delivery: Manage courier and delivery partner performance, bookings, service standards and delivery exceptions.



Customer outcomes: Work with customer service to identify delivery risks early, agree realistic solutions and ensure customers receive clear updates.



Exception management: Resolve competing priorities, delayed movements, failed deliveries and urgent orders, understanding the wider impact of each decision.



Commercial performance: Monitor cost per delivery, linehaul utilisation, redelivery costs and other controllable expenses, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency.



Team coordination: Give clear direction, establish ownership and hold internal teams and external partners accountable for agreed actions.



Back office Admin: Leading our back office admin team who liaises with locally based suppliers, will also form part of this positions' remit.



Continuous improvement: Strengthen processes, reporting and systems so the operation becomes more reliable and easier to manage.



You’ll also step into the operation when needed—investigating an issue on the warehouse floor, checking an order or helping the team through a peak period.



What you’ll bring

Strong experience in fulfilment, transport or last mile operations, ideally within furniture, bulky goods, retail or a similar delivery environment.



Experience coordinating warehouses, interstate linehaul movements and external delivery partners.



The ability to make sound decisions when priorities compete and information is incomplete.



Commercial awareness: you understand how delivery promises, stock movements, storage constraints and transport choices affect cost and service.



Confidence using operational data and warehouse, ERP and delivery systems to identify issues and guide decisions.



Clear communication and the ability to work effectively with warehouse teams, customer service, suppliers and senior management.



A practical approach, strong follow-through and a willingness to get involved when needed.



What success looks like



Customer orders move predictably from warehouse to delivery. Stock transfers are planned with both capacity and cost in mind. Delivery risks are identified early, avoidable costs are reduced, and everyone involved understands the priorities and their responsibilities.

title: Experienced Part Time Appointment Setter (3+ Years Cold Calling Sales) for Commercial Cleaning, Healthcare Offices (US)
description:
Keeper Facility Care is a commercial cleaning company for healthcare offices in Fairfield County, Connecticut (
). We need one experienced part time appointment setter to reach the decision maker at healthcare offices and book short walkthroughs. This is a sales job. We are not looking for beginners.



THE JOB

You work from a list we give you. Your one goal is a booked 15 minute walkthrough with the decision maker: the office manager, practice manager, administrator or owner.



Your standard is 100 or more dials every working day, from day one. A dial is one call attempt to one number. The same number twice in one day counts once.



Your work:

You call the decision maker directly on their business line when we have it, and you call the office main line and get through to them.

You follow up by
, and by text to numbers the prospect gave you.

You answer inbound calls and return missed calls from offices we have already contacted.

You log every call in our CRM and send a confirmation within 10 minutes of each booking.



Your rules:

You dial by hand, call business lines only, never quote prices, never promise anything free, never claim we do something we do not do, and stop when someone says do not call.



Most calls end at the front desk or in voi
. That is normal. We want someone who stays polite and keeps dialing.



HOW WE SELL

This is not a job where you read a script. We give you talking points and guardrails, and you have a natural conversation. We want someone who sounds confident and human on the phone, listens, and understands why a clean office matters to a healthcare practice: its patients, its staff and its reputation. Worked at a commercial cleaning, janitorial or facility services company? That is a strong plus.



HOURS

20 hours per week, Monday to Friday, mostly Tuesday to Thursday. Calls run 10 AM to 12 PM and 1 PM to 4 PM US Eastern time. In Philippine time that is 10 PM to 12 AM and 1 AM to 4 AM until November 1, then one hour later because US clocks change. These are US business hours, so they fall at night in the Philippines. Apply only if you can work these hours every week. Hours can grow for strong performers.



PAY

$5 to $7 per hour depending on experience, paid weekly in USD by Wise or Payoneer.

$25 for every walkthrough that actually happens.

$50, $75 or $100 for every office that signs, based on contract size ($1,400 to $2,000 a month, $2,001 to $3,000, $3,001 and up). Paid after we collect the first invoice.

Bonuses are extra and not promised.



TRIAL

The first 80 hours are a paid trial. We track dials, decision maker conversations, walkthroughs booked and walkthroughs held on a weekly scorecard. Then we review your numbers together and d
 whether to continue. You sign a contractor agreement with confidentiality and non-compete terms before day one.



WE PROVIDE

A US phone number and dialer, our CRM, the call list, talking points and objection answers, written playbooks for calling, CRM use and the weekly scorecard, role-play training in week one, and a 15 minute performance review every week.



YOU NEED

At least 3 years of experience as an outbound cold calling appointment setter, booking appointments for service businesses, to businesses or to consumers. Home services, cleaning, healthcare, insurance and similar services count. Calling US customers for a client, at a call center or as a freelancer, counts. If you do not have 3 years of appointment setting by cold calling, do not apply.

You have made 100 or more cold calls a day before, and you know how to get past a front desk and reach the decision maker. You stay calm after a lot of no's.

A natural, confident phone presence. You sound like a person, not a script.

Daily experience using a CRM, and clean call notes.

Clear spoken English that a US office manager understands on the first call.

A computer, a USB headset, a quiet room, and 10 Mbps upload speed.

Put this title on the first line of your message: KEEPER, [the hourly pay range in this post], [your name]. I do not read messages without it.



Then send:



1. A link to a 30 to 45 second voice recording. Do not read a script. Introduce yourself in one sentence. title: Operations & Automation Manager (Amazon Agency, ClickUp + Automations)
description:
We are an Amazon advertising and brand-growth agency. We run the Amazon channel for about 25 consumer brands as their fractional Amazon COO: ads, listings, creative, catalog, inventory and strategy. The team is small and fully remote, and you report to the two founders with nobody in between.



THE JOB



Our tools don't talk to each other yet. Leads land in GoHighLevel, delivery runs in ClickUp, list work runs in Clay, and the links between them are thin or missing. One of our Make scenarios has never completed a single run. You build those links, then you keep them running. This is build work: you design the automations, ship them, and own them when they break.



WHAT YOU BUILD AND OWN



- The connections between ClickUp, GoHighLevel, Clay, Make or n8n, Missive, Google Drive, Slack and Stripe. A positive sales reply, a signed client, a new client task: each moves to the next system without a person copying it by hand.

- ClickUp as the single source of truth: one standard space per client, statuses, owners, dependencies, recurring work, and dashboards a founder can read in thirty seconds.

- Tasks that arrive complete, with the details, the owner and the definition of done.

- Plumbing for sales: alerts on target accounts, Clay tables, routing a reply into the pipeline.

- SOPs you write, get followed, and keep current.

- A quality gate: deliverables checked against a written standard before a client sees them.

- Early warnings: deadlines, blockers and quiet accounts reach the founders before a client raises them.



WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE



Day 30: the broken things work. The Make scenario completes runs, the shared inbox has a triage rule, and every client space follows one skeleton.

Day 60: one new connection between two systems is live and in use. A weekly operations report reaches the founders without anyone asking.

Day 90: the founders stop asking "did anyone do this?"



WHAT YOU NEED



- Operations or systems experience at an agency or service business, beyond a coordinator role.

- ClickUp at administrator depth: spaces, custom fields, automations, dashboards. You will show this on a screen recording.

- Automations you built yourself. Make experience is a strong plus; n8n, Zapier or API work also counts. At minimum, you can open a broken scenario and work out why it stopped.

- GoHighLevel is a plus, and you can learn it. If you have run HubSpot or another CRM, you will pick it up fast.

- Evidence you fixed a system you inherited broken.

- A procedure you wrote that somebody else followed without asking you a question.

- Daily use of AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT in your work.

- Care with data. When you show us past work, client details are removed.



Not required: Amazon knowledge or advertising experience.



Hours: flexible, with some overlap with US Pacific business hours each weekday.



Tools: ClickUp, GoHighLevel, Clay, Make, n8n, Missive, Instantly, HeyReach, Google Workspace, Slack, Fireflies, Claude.



HOW TO APPLY



Put the phrase FIX THE RAILS at the top of your application. Use this exact phrase for this role only. We do not read applications without it.



Then send:

1. Your resume or LinkedIn.

2. One automation or integration you built between two tools: what it does, and the last time it broke.

3. One system you inherited broken and repaired: what broke, how you found it, what you changed, how you know it is fixed.

4. The hours you can work each weekday, in US Pacific time.

5. Your monthly rate in USD.



HOW WE HIRE



We hire slowly and on purpose.

1. Application. We reply to every complete application within 5 business days, yes or no.

2. Work sample, about 45 minutes, including a 3 to 5 minute screen recording of a ClickUp workspace you administer.

3. Video call with a founder, built around your work sample.

4. Paid trial for finalists on a sanitized copy of our real operations. You are paid whether or not we hire you.

5. Offer. Both founders review your work first.



BENEFITS



- Fully remote, async-friendly team.

- 10 paid days off a year, after a 90-day probation.

- The major public holidays of the country you work from.

- Performance-based bonuses.

- Direct access to the two founders. Weekly check-ins, fast feedback, no layers.

- Room to grow. Compensation moves with what you can hold.



We are an equal opportunity employer. We d
 on the work you show us.

BENEFITS

- The major public holidays of the country you work from.

- Performance-based bonuses.

- Direct access to the two founders. Weekly check-ins, fast feedback, no layers.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We d
 on the work you show us.

title: Short-form Content Creator (TikTok + Instagram), AI Websites + AI Tools niche
description:
We're NoCodeWithAI, a faceless brand that shows small business owners how to build their website with AI, with no code. We sell a digital website kit and give away a free launch checklist. You'll get our full kit FREE to learn the method and use in your content.



YOUR JOB HAS 2 PARTS



1. REMIX VIRAL CONTENT (about half your videos)

- We send you viral TikToks and Reels about building websites with AI and AI tools in general (Claude, ChatGPT and similar).

- You remix them into ORIGINAL versions for our page: same type of hook, format and pacing, but our topic, our words and your own edit.

- Never re-upload, screen-record or copy anyone's video, script or captions.



2. CREATE LEAD-GENERATING CONTENT FOR OUR PRODUCTS (about half your videos)

- Show real examples of building websites with AI: before/afters, quick builds, "I asked Claude to build a bakery website", tips that make AI websites look better.

- Each of these points viewers to our free website launch checklist (link in bio), and sometimes to our No-Code Website Kit.

- The aim is leads: people who sign up for the free checklist and buy the kit.



ALSO

- Edit short vertical videos (CapCut or similar) and write hooks and captions.

- Post 1 video a day on our TikTok, plus a reworded version on our Instagram (not the same caption).

- Reply to comments once or twice a day.

- Send a short weekly report: posts, views, followers, link clicks, checklist sign-ups if you can see them.



YOU MUST

- Send links to 3 short-form videos you made (any niche).

- Use AI tools already (ChatGPT, Claude, AI website builders), or be keen to learn fast with our kit.

- Write natural, simple English.



OUR RULES

- Faceless brand, so you don't need to show your face.

- No fake reviews, fake results or made-up numbers. Label AI-generated content.

- Never re-upload other creators' videos.



PAY

- About 15 hours a week, flexible.

- $150–300 a month depending on experience, paid weekly via Wise (to your bank or GCash) or OnlineJobs EasyPay, for work done that week. We cover the transfer fees.

- Raise after 2 months based on results.



HOW WE HIRE

1. Paid trial task ($15): we send you one viral reference video, and you make our remix of it about building a website with AI. Paid on delivery.

2. 2-week paid trial, then we review together.



TO APPLY: send your 3 best video links and one sentence on which AI tool you use most and why. Start your message with "WEBSITE" so we know you read this.
