For candidates who perform well, there is a clear path toward closing and other senior sales positions. If you are motivated, disciplined on the phone, and interested in building a career in AI-driven B2B sales, we encourage you to apply.

title: Medical Billing Specialist
description:
We are seeking an experienced and highly organized Medical Billing Specialist to join our growing behavioral health practice. This position focuses primarily on medical billing, insurance follow-up, accounts receivable, denial management, payment posting, and collections, with opportunities to assist with provider credentialing and payer enrollment as needed.



The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience managing the full revenue cycle and understands the importance of timely, accurate billing and persistent insurance follow-up. Behavioral health or psychiatry billing experience is strongly preferred.



Key Responsibilities



Medical Billing & Revenue Cycle



* Prepare, review, and submit clean electronic and paper claims to commercial and government payers.

* Review daily billing activity to ensure claims are submitted accurately and timely through the clearinghouse.

* Review patient charges and supporting documentation for coding and billing accuracy.

* Monitor claim status and promptly resolve claim rejections, clearinghouse edits, and denials.

* Prepare and submit corrected claims, reconsiderations, and formal appeals.

* Post insurance payments, patient payments, contractual adjustments, and write-offs accurately.

* Reconcile payments and identify underpayments or reimbursement discrepancies.

* Verify insurance eligibility and benefits when necessary.

* Maintain complete and accurate documentation of billing activity within the practice management system.

* Ensure billing practices comply with payer requirements, HIPAA, and applicable regulations.



Insurance Follow-Up & Accounts Receivable



* Proactively follow up on outstanding claims with insurance carriers through payer portals, telephone calls, and written correspondence.

* Research and resolve unpaid, underpaid, rejected, and denied claims

* Work insurance aging reports and prioritize accounts requiring immediate follow-up.

* Identify recurring denial and payment trends and escalate systemic issues to management.

* Track appeals and corrected claims through final resolution.

* Assist with reducing aging A/R and improving overall collection performance.

* Communicate with patients regarding outstanding balances professionally and respectfully.

* Collect applicable copayments, deductibles, coinsurance, and other patient-responsibility balances.

* Send patient statements and correspondence explaining outstanding balances.

* Respond to patient billing questions and assist with resolving payment disputes.

* Recommend accounts for payment arrangements, collections, or management review when appropriate.



Credentialing & Payer Enrollment



* Assist with provider credentialing and recredentialing applications.

* Maintain accurate and current CAQH profiles.

* Assist with enrollment of providers with commercial insurance plans, Medicare, Medicaid, and other payer networks.

* Track credentialing and enrollment applications from submission through approval.

* Maintain provider documentation, including licenses, DEA registrations, malpractice coverage, and board certifications.

* Monitor credentialing expiration dates and renewal requirements.

* Communicate with payer representatives to resolve enrollment or credentialing issues.



 Reporting & Administrative Responsibilities



* Perform daily, weekly, and monthly billing and revenue-cycle reconciliation activities.

* Generate and review billing, collections, denial, and A/R aging reports.

* Identify trends in denials, underpayments, and reimbursement issues and recommend process improvements.

* Maintain strict confidentiality of patient information and comply with HIPAA requirements.

* Collaborate with providers, front-office staff, and management to improve billing accuracy and reimbursement.

* Perform additional revenue-cycle responsibilities as assigned.



Qualifications



Experience



* **3–5 years of medical billing, insurance follow-up, and collections experience required.

* Behavioral health, mental health, or psychiatry billing experience strongly preferred

* Experience working with commercial insurance plans, Medicare, and Medicaid.

* Demonstrated experience resolving denied, rejected, and underpaid claims.

* Experience with electronic health records (EHR), practice management systems, and clearinghouses.

* Knowledge of corrected claims, reconsiderations, appeals, payment posting, and A/R management.

* Credentialing or payer enrollment experience is a plus.

* Strong understanding of HIPAA, payer requirements, and medical billing guidelines.



Skills



* Strong understanding of the complete medical revenue cycle

* Excellent organizational and time-management skills.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

* Effective written and verbal communication skills.

* Ability to independently manage a high-volume A/R workload and meet deadlines.

* Ability to communicate professionally with insurance representatives, patients, providers, and management.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.

* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced healthcare environment.



Preferred Qualifications



* Medical Billing and Coding Certificate or professional certification such as CPC, CPB, or CRCR 

* Behavioral health or psychiatry billing experience.

* Experience billing **telehealth and behavioral health services

* Familiarity with DrChrono or similar EHR/practice management systems.

* Experience with provider credentialing, CAQH, and payer enrollment.



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who does more than simply submit claims. The successful candidate will own the revenue cycle, consistently follow up on outstanding claims through resolution, investigate reimbursement discrepancies, identify denial trends, and help ensure services are appropriately reimbursed.



The ideal candidate is proactive, persistent, detail-oriented, accountable, and comfortable working independently while communicating effectively with the broader practice team.

title: Scriptwriter & Creative Ops Associate - Davao based only
description:
Reports to: Senior Creative Director

Setup: Full-time, on-site at our Davao based Studio

Working Hours: 8:00 AM–4:00 PM Philippine Time



About the Role

We’re looking for a Scriptwriter & Creative Ops Associate to support our YouTube content production and day-to-day creative operations.

This is a hands-on, hybrid creative and operations role. Your primary responsibility will be researching and writing scripts for Shane Hummus’ YouTube content, while also helping ensure everything surrounding content production runs smoothly — including studio setup, recordings, webinars, slides, SMS campaigns, and other marketing operations.

Approximately 60% of the role is focused on scriptwriting, research, and sourcing strong examples, with the remaining time split across studio production, webinar operations, and marketing support.

This role is best suited for someone who is highly resourceful, comfortable using AI tools every day, learns quickly, notices small details, and can solve problems without waiting for step-by-step instructions.

You do not need to already know every system we use. We care more about your judgment, curiosity, ability to learn quickly, and willingness to improve through feedback.



Key Responsibilities

1. Scriptwriting & Research — Core Responsibility

Research and write approximately 6–8 YouTube scripts per week, depending on the video format and production schedule.

Source compelling examples, case studies, references, screenshots, demonstrations, and supporting material for each script.

Evaluate examples based on two key questions:

Is this strong enough to create a “wow” moment for the viewer?

Does it contextually fit the point being made in the video?

Structure scripts to be engaging, clear, easy to follow, and optimized for Shane’s delivery style.

Prepare scripts in Google Docs, formatted so they can be read directly during recording.

Research unfamiliar topics quickly and turn complex information into simple, usable content.

Support tutorial/how-to content by:

Completing or testing the process yourself.

Screen-recording the process when needed.

Turning that demonstration into a clear script Shane can follow while recording.

Use AI tools heavily for research, ideation, proof of concept, and example sourcing while applying independent judgment to verify that outputs actually make sense.

2. Studio & Recording Operations

Prepare the studio before scheduled recordings.

Set up and check cameras, microphones, audio, framing, and other recording equipment.

Identify issues such as audio crackling, hum, dropouts, poor framing, or recording problems before the shoot begins.

Troubleshoot basic production issues in real time.

QA recorded footage before handing it over to the editing team.

Confirm recordings are complete, usable, and ready for post-production.

3. Live Training & Webinar Operations

Help build and manage presentation decks for live trainings and webinars.

Review and QA slides before each session.

Make last-minute slide additions or adjustments based on feedback from Shane or the creative team.

Coordinate with team members handling delegated slide production and own the final quality check.

Moderate the weekly live webinar and VIP session every Wednesday.

Monitor attendance and help ensure the technical side of the event runs smoothly.

4. Marketing Operations

Help manage and troubleshoot SMS campaigns and related systems.

Verify that SMS messages and reminders are actually delivering correctly.

Monitor live webinar attendance and coordinate additional SMS pushes with the marketing team when needed.

Identify technical or delivery issues before they affect a campaign or live session.

Support the marketing team with campaign execution, automations, troubleshooting, and other operational needs.

5. Creative Ideation & Strategy Support

Participate in brainstorm sessions with Shane and the Senior Creative Director.

Research and pitch potential YouTube topics, formats, examples, and angles.

Provide thoughtful opinions and creative feedback rather than simply taking notes.

Help evaluate whether an idea is strong enough to pursue before significant production time is invested.

6. Client Deliverables

Occasionally support done-for-you creative or content deliverables for higher-tier clients.

Client work is not necessarily weekly and may come in short bursts depending on business needs.



Tools & Technology

Must Know or Be Comfortable Learning Immediately

Claude — used extensively for research, proof of concept, scripting support, and example sourcing.

ChatGPT and other AI/LLM tools

Google Docs

Google Drive

AI is deeply integrated into our workflow. We are looking for someone who naturally uses tools such as Claude and ChatGPT to research, test ideas, find answers, and move faster — without blindly trusting AI-generated information.

Tools You May Learn on the Job

ActiveCampaign

Twilio

GoHighLevel

Webinar/live-streaming platforms

Zoom

Google Slides

Canva

Screen-recording tools

Basic audio/video recording equipment

Slack



Nice to Have

Marketing automation experience

YouTube content or scriptwriting experience

Audio/video production experience

Experience working with creators, agencies, or content teams

Tutorial/how-to scriptwriting experience

Familiarity with webinars or online training events

We care more about tool judgment than memorizing specific software. You should be able to learn a new tool quickly, understand why it is being used, and recognize when something isn't working as intended.



Qualifications

Strong writing and research skills.

Comfortable using AI tools as part of your daily workflow.

Strong attention to detail and quality control.

Able to work independently and figure things out without constant supervision.

Strong logical thinking and problem-solving skills.

Comfortable receiving direct feedback and revising work quickly.

Able to manage both creative work and operational responsibilities.

Organized and dependable when handling deadlines, recordings, and live events.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Willingness to work on-site full-time.

Prior professional scriptwriting experience is helpful but not required if you demonstrate strong writing ability, judgment, and trainability.



Who Will Struggle in This Role

This role is likely not a good fit if you:

Need constant instructions before taking action.

Regularly wait for someone to assign your next task.

Say you understand something but don't investigate when you're unsure.

Are uncomfortable submitting drafts or making mistakes.

Expect to know every tool before you are willing to use it.

Struggle with direct feedback or detailed QA.

Only want to write and have no interest in operations or production.

Only want to handle operations and aren't comfortable writing.

Rarely use AI tools or aren't interested in making them part of your daily workflow.



Success Metrics

Success in this role will be measured by:

Consistently delivering approximately 6–8 high-quality scripts per week based on production needs.

Scripts requiring progressively fewer major revisions over time.

Strong, relevant examples sourced for each piece of content.

Recording sessions running smoothly with production issues identified before they affect usable footage.

Webinar slides and live sessions being accurate, polished, and ready on time.

SMS and webinar systems operating reliably with issues caught quickly.

Increasing ability to independently solve creative and operational problems.

Proactive contribution to video ideas, research, and team brainstorms.

Reduced need for Shane and senior creative leadership to handle routine production and operational tasks.



The Ideal Candidate

You don't need to be an expert at ten different things.

We would rather hire someone who is genuinely strong in one area — especially writing, research, or creative thinking — and has excellent judgment, curiosity, and the ability to learn quickly than someone who is average at everything.

This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to become deeply involved in the operations of a high-performing YouTube and education business, develop their creative skills, and work closely with an experienced content team.

If your instinct when you encounter something unfamiliar is:

“I don't know this yet, but I'll figure it out.”

You'll probably fit in well here.



WHAT WE OFFER

- Year end bonus

- No TIME TRACKER 

- HMO, dental, mental health & telemedicine coverage (after 6-month tenure)

- Paid week-long Christmas leave + PTO + Birthday gift, Work Anniversary 

- Workshops plus financial & credit support

Start your application message with the word "STORYTELLER" so we know you read this.

Applying via email?

 with the subject line:

Script Writer (Davao Based) — [Your Full Name]

title: Construction Finance Analyst (Project Accounting)
description:
Title: Construction Finance Analyst (Project Accounting)  

Company: Suffren Financial  

Location: Remote (US)  

Type: Full-time



About Suffren Financial



Suffren Financial is a construction-focused accounting and fractional CFO firm for residential homebuilders and small real estate developers. We act as the outsourced finance department for builders running multiple ground‑up projects per year.



The Construction Finance Analyst is the person who turns messy builder data into clean, project‑level financials and lender‑ready reporting. You’ll live in the numbers: job costing, WIP, draws, and project P&Ls.



You do not need to be a construction accounting expert on day one. We have a defined way we want things done and will train you on our playbooks, cost‑code structure, and reporting templates. What we care about most is that you are sharp, coachable, and obsessive about getting the details right.



You’ll report to our Fractional CFO / Lead Accountant and work inside our proprietary construction finance system.



What you’ll do



Day to day, you will:



• Set up new projects in our internal system and QuickBooks (entities, cost codes, budgets, loan details).  

• Perform detailed job costing: code vendor invoices, credit card charges, and payroll to the correct project and cost code.  

• Reconcile bank, credit card, and loan accounts weekly and clear discrepancies.  

• Maintain project‑level P&Ls, WIP schedules, and draw/loan tracking for each active job.  

• Prepare lender- and investor‑ready packages: project reports, portfolio summaries, and supporting schedules.  

• Support cleanup/onboarding projects (often year‑end or multi‑year): reconstruct prior‑year project financials from bank statements, invoices, and existing books.  

• Coordinate with clients’ controllers/bookkeepers to gather missing documentation and clarify transaction coding.  

• Flag margin issues, budget overruns, and anomalies for the CFO to review with the client.  

• Document processes and checklists so the work can be repeated consistently across clients.



What success looks like (first 90 days)



• Close month‑end for assigned clients within 5–7 business days with >99% of transactions coded.  

• Deliver WIP / project P&Ls and lender packages on or before agreed deadlines.  

• Keep unreconciled items older than 30 days to an agreed low threshold.  

• Ask good questions, follow the playbook, and reduce rework from the CFO/Lead Accountant.



Requirements



• 1–3+ years in accounting or finance (public, private, or bookkeeping).  

• Working knowledge of QuickBooks Online and Excel/Google Sheets.  

• Comfortable reconciling accounts and working with large volumes of transactions.  

• Coachable and process‑driven: you follow a proven workflow, take feedback well, and improve fast.  

• High attention to detail; you like reconciling things until they tie to the penny.  

• Self‑directed in a remote environment; you can manage a recurring monthly workload without hand‑holding.



Nice to have



• Experience with residential homebuilders, GCs, or small real estate developers.  

• Exposure to job costing, WIP, percentage‑of‑completion, or project‑based P&Ls.  

• Familiarity with construction draws, lender packages, or investor reporting.



If that matches how you like to work and you want to specialize in construction finance, we’d like to talk.

title: Customer Support & Fulfillment Team Lead
description:
About the role



We are a direct-to-consumer supplement brand serving customers worldwide, with most of our customers based in the United States. We are looking for an experienced Customer Support & Fulfillment Team Lead to oversee our customer support operation and monitor the accuracy and performance of our fulfillment processes.



You will lead the Customer Support team, make sure our SOPs are followed, and ensure customer and operational issues are handled accurately and promptly. You will also oversee payment disputes and work closely with Fulfillment and Management to identify recurring problems and improve our processes.



This is a hands-on role combining team leadership, quality control, operational oversight, and reporting.





Key responsibilities



Core responsibilities



- Manage and support the Customer Support team in its daily work.

- Review customer conversations regularly and coach agents on quality, accuracy, tone, and SOP compliance.

- Ensure customers receive timely responses and that urgent, sensitive, or high-risk cases are prioritized.

- Monitor fulfillment cases, including order errors, replacements, address changes, shipping delays, lost packages, and tracking exceptions.

- Coordinate clearly and promptly between Customer Support, Fulfillment, Management, and other teams.

- Manage and oversee PayPal disputes, Shopify chargebacks, and other payment-related cases.

- Take ownership of escalated issues and follow them through to resolution.

- Maintain and improve SOPs as policies, tools, and workflows change.



Reporting and process improvement



- Prepare regular KPI reports for Management, covering ticket volume, response and resolution times, customer satisfaction, refunds, cancellation reasons, disputes, and fulfillment issues.

- Identify patterns in customer complaints, operational errors, and team performance.

- Recommend and help implement improvements to workflows, SOPs, customer experience, and fulfillment coordination.

- Escalate critical issues and recurring risks with clear context and recommended next steps.



Required experience and skills



- Previous experience as a Customer Support Team Lead, Customer Experience Manager, Operations Manager, or in a similar role, preferably in e-commerce.

- Experience leading or coordinating remote customer support teams.

- Hands-on experience with Shopify, including orders, customer accounts, refunds, cancellations, fulfillment statuses, and chargebacks.

- Experience with subscription-based e-commerce and platforms such as Loop Subscriptions or similar tools.

- Strong understanding of subscription workflows, including cancellations, skips, pauses, frequency changes, rebills, retention offers, and subscription-related complaints.

- Experience handling PayPal disputes and Shopify chargebacks, with an understanding of dispute prevention and chargeback reduction.

- Experience working with fulfillment centers, 3PLs, warehouses, or international fulfillment partners.

- Ability to investigate tracking issues, shipping exceptions, lost packages, replacement requests, address problems, and fulfillment errors.

- Experience defining, monitoring, and reporting Customer Support KPIs.

- Strong quality-control, auditing, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

- Experience writing, improving, and enforcing SOPs.

- Fluent English, both written and spoken, is required, as most of our customers are based in the United States.

- Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills.

- Ability to make sound decisions independently and take ownership of issues through resolution.



Helpful additional experience



- Experience in the supplements, health, or wellness industry.

- Experience supporting customers with product-related concerns and escalating potential safety issues appropriately.

- Familiarity with customer support platforms, subscription tools, and reporting dashboards.

- German language skills are a plus.



A quick note for applicants



To confirm that you have read the full job description, begin your application with the word TRACK.

What's Hard About This Job

Working Remotely - We're a remote-first company, and we never want to have an office. This is great if you like working by yourself in the quiet, but it can be terribly painful if you need the energy of coworkers nearby.

Our Cultural Values - We're an American company with an incredibly unusual culture. Even by American standards, our 7 cultural values are highly unusual. Our culture is challenging for people accustomed to corporate culture and especially difficult for people who grew up in Confucian cultures. It's a great culture for people who speak directly and have a great deal of self-confidence and ownership. If you identify as a misfit, you'll do well.

Secret Message - When you apply, you'll see a box that asks if you want to add anything else. Type in PINK ELEPHANT in all capital letters exactly as we've shown it here.





Cheat Code for getting a job with us:

1) Our application comprises the majority of our recruiting process. Because of that, we suggest that you give us thoughtful responses and rich stories. We typically only interview applicants who give rich and detailed answers to our questions. If you write short responses so that you can hurry up and finish the application, you will not get interviewed.

2) Tell us stories about how your actions match your beliefs and values. For example, if I say I value health and fitness, you don't know if I'm telling you the truth or if I'm just telling you what sounds good. But, if I tell you things I've done, I can illustrate my values of health and fitness with proof. For example, I go to the gym 4 days per week, I've done 6 triathlons, including an Ironman, and I can swim 3000 meters in one hour. My examples of things I've done prove that my actions match my values system.

3) Be vulnerable and honest. We take very detailed notes during the interview process, and we conduct extensive background checks. If the stories you tell about yourself don't match what your references say, we will not hire you. We'd rather hire a C student who is honest about being a C student than someone who is a C student but tries to pass themselves off as an A student. Remember, this is an entry-level job. We're not looking for perfect. We're looking for an excellent cultural fit.

title: Client Account Manager – Accounting & Advisory (AI-Augmented US Firm)
description:
Compensation (Paid Monthly via Fixed Retainers):

• Level 1 (Micro-Accounts / Airbnb / Real Estate): $50 USD / month flat baseline.

• Level 2 (Standard Business / Tax Firm Accounts): $100 USD / month flat baseline.

• Advisory & Workload Add-ons: Base rates increase by +$50 to +$100 USD / month per account as you assume advanced services (such as client budgeting, forecasting, and running direct client financial review calls).

• High-Level Corporate Portfolios: As the firm scales, complex portfolios carry starting baselines ranging from $300 to $500+ USD / month.

About Our Firm

Profit First Taxes is a modern, high-efficiency United States-based tax and accounting firm led by an Enrolled Agent (EA). We operate primarily on US Eastern Time. Our firm leverages cutting-edge technology and QuickBooks AI to eliminate 80% of traditional manual data entry.

We serve a stable, highly automated portfolio of clients, including real estate/Airbnb investors, e-commerce brands, and local businesses, alongside our own corporate books. We do not hire traditional data-entry clerks who simply want to click buttons. We hire articulate, analytical, and autonomous Account Managers who act as the pilots of our automation, protect our data hygiene, and help deliver high-level financial insights to our clients.

Position Overview

You will manage a select portfolio of US-based business accounts under the direct mentorship of an Enrolled Agent. Because our software handles the routine data matching, your value lies in your critical thinking, data auditing, and professional communication. You must be completely comfortable working independently, taking initiative when the firm owner is unavailable, and communicating directly with clients.

Core Responsibilities & Strict Deadlines

• Supervise the Automation: Review and approve automated QuickBooks AI transaction classifications weekly. Proactively maintain tight bank rules to keep matching accuracy above 85%.

• Reconciliations & Diagnostics: Perform complete month-end reconciliations for bank accounts, credit cards, and specialized e-commerce/merchant platforms.

• The 10th-of-the-Month Closeout Rule: All assigned accounts must be fully closed and reconciled within 10 days of month-end. You are required to submit a mandatory 5-to-10 minute screen-share video (using Loom) by 11:59 PM Eastern Time on the 10th of every month showing successful reconciliation screens.

• The 14th Correction Deadline: PFT reviews all submissions between the 11th and 13th. All corrections must be fully completed and resubmitted by 11:59 PM Eastern Time on the 14th to satisfy the completion standard for that month's compensation cycle.

• AI-Driven Advisory Prep: Extract quarterly financial statements, leverage advanced LLMs (ChatGPT or Gemini) to investigate variances, and refine the output into a professional executive summary.

• Direct Client Communication: Act as the primary point of contact for your assigned accounts. Independently schedule short appointments with clients via the firm's calendar to go over their monthly or quarterly books and answer questions.

Mandatory Performance & Contract Terms

1. Flat-Rate, All-Inclusive Structure: The monthly flat retainer per account is fully inclusive of all operational tasks, including transaction checking, reconciliations, client scheduling, async Loom video updates, and necessary internal review meetings. No additional hourly billing or meeting fees are permitted.

2. Review-Ready Standard: Marking an account as "Review-Ready" means all bank rules are verified, miscellaneous/suspense accounts are completely cleared, and the ledger is ready for the EA's final sign-off without routine cleanup.

3. No Automatic Tenure Increases: Length of service does not grant automatic raises. Compensation scaling is strictly tied to your willingness to assume advanced advisory tasks (like budgeting) and your demonstrated accuracy.

Required Qualifications

• Tax & Accounting Firm Experience: Minimum of 2–3 years of direct experience working inside a US-based CPA firm, tax firm, or accounting practice. You must thoroughly understand the connection between daily bookkeeping entries and clean, tax-ready financial statements.

• E-Commerce & Real Estate Fluency: Proven experience managing books for US small businesses, S-Corps, real estate/Airbnb operations, and Shopify environments.

• Degree in Accounting: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field is strictly required.

• Tech-Forward Mindset: Highly proficient with QuickBooks Online, advanced bank rules, and utilizing ChatGPT or Gemini for financial analysis documentation.

• Excellent Spoken English: Completely confident and articulate when speaking directly with US business owners over video calls.

• BIG PLUS – Tax Preparation Experience: Candidates who have verified experience preparing US federal tax returns (Form 1040, 1120S, or 1065) will be heavily prioritized. While this is primarily an Account Manager position, an opportunity exists for a high-paying dual role where you can take on separate tax preparation workloads during the busy US tax season.

⚠️ MANDATORY APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

To apply, you must reply with the exact subject line: "Ready to Pilot the Automation for PFT".

Your application message must include a link to a 3-to-5 minute Loom video addressing the two practical scenarios below.

Note: You do not need—and should not use—a live QuickBooks account for this demonstration. You are entirely free to use any creative presentation method you prefer (such as opening a blank spreadsheet, typing into a notepad document, or prompting live inside ChatGPT/Gemini on screen) to verbally explain and demonstrate your problem-solving process. We want to see how you process information, think critically, and communicate financial concepts on your feet.

Scenario A: The Shopify Payout Discrepancy

• The Situation: A client’s bank feed shows a clean net deposit from Shopify for $4,500. However, the Shopify store backend shows that gross sales for that exact period were actually $5,000, with $300 in merchant fees and $200 in sales tax collected.

• Your Task: Share your screen and verbally walk us through the step-by-step accounting logic of how you would handle and process this situation so the final business financials remain 100% tax-ready and accurate.

Scenario B: The AI Financial Analysis

• The Situation: A client’s Profit & Loss statement shows that "Advertising Expenses" suddenly spiked from $1,200 last month to $4,800 this month, while their gross revenue only increased by 5%.

• Your Task: Share your screen and demonstrate or explain how you would leverage an advanced Large Language Model (like ChatGPT or Gemini) to investigate this variance and prepare a concise, high-level, 3-bullet-point executive summary for the firm owner.

Applications that fail to use the correct subject line or fail to provide the open-ended Loom video link will be automatically archived without review.

description:

This is an entry-level position that is eligible for growth.





About Us



Started in 2017 and we're growing like crazy.

Growing FAST - We sold 2663 lessons in 2025 and we're on pace to sell 3328 lessons in 2026.

A small team of 1 American and 10 Filipinos.

We sell manual transmission driving lessons in the United States. Yes, really.

Compensation and Benefits

Compensation:

$4 per hour

Benefits to be provided after completion of 3 months:

Health Insurance



Type of Employment

Full Time

40 hours per week

Schedule - 9 AM to 5 PM EST





Entry Level Details

Note that this is an entry-level job.

We do NOT expect you to have any prior sales experience.

If you’re looking to switch careers and get your foot in the door, this could be great for you.

We will train you on how to take customers through the sales process.

This is a great opportunity for anyone with a background in any of the following areas: Cold Caller, Remote Cold Caller, Cold Caller / Appointment Setter, B2B Cold Caller, Outbound Sales Representative, Outbound Appointment Setter, Sales Appointment Setter, Telemarketing Representative, Telesales Representative, Lead Generation Specialist, Sales Development Representative, SDR, Business Development Representative, BDR, Outbound Call Center Agent, Virtual Assistant – Cold Calling, Phone Sales Representative





Duties and Responsibilities

Make a high volume of outbound calls each day to businesses.

Follow call scripts, workflows, and basic procedures.

Log call outcomes and notes accurately.

Send follow-up emails and text messages when necessary.

Secret Message: When you apply, under the section that says "Is there anything else you'd like to write or include?", write the word PINKELEPHANT. This will show us that you read the entire job description.

Identify decision-makers and schedule callbacks or appointments.

Communicate feedback and common objections to the team.



Requirements

Previous experience in cold calling, telemarketing, appointment setting, or a similar outbound sales role.

Experience making a large number of calls daily.

Ability to follow a defined process and use scripts effectively.

Strong conversational and listening skills.

Comfortable handling rejection and maintaining a positive attitude.

Excellent spoken English and clear communication skills.

Dependable internet connection and a quiet work environment.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience calling businesses or working in B2B sales.

Familiarity with CRMs and dialing software.

Experience working remotely.







What's Hard About This Job

Working Remotely - We're a remote-first company, and we never want to have an office. This is great if you like working by yourself in the quiet, but it can be terribly painful if you need the energy of coworkers nearby.

Our Cultural Values - We're an American company with an incredibly unusual culture. Even by American standards, our 7 cultural values are highly unusual. Our culture is challenging for people accustomed to corporate culture and especially difficult for people who grew up in Confucian cultures. It's a great culture for people who speak directly and have a great deal of self-confidence and ownership. If you identify as a misfit, you'll do well.

Multiple Software Systems - You're going to need to learn how to use 12 different software systems. This is great if you want to get exposed to and experience lots of technology, but it can be tough if you have a hard time learning technology. Secret Message - When you apply, you'll see a box that asks if you want to add anything else. Type in PINKELEPHANT in all capital letters exactly as we've shown it here.





Cheat Code for getting a job with us:

1) Our application comprises the majority of our recruiting process. Because of that, we suggest that you give us thoughtful responses and rich stories. We typically only interview applicants who give rich and detailed answers to our questions. If you write short responses so that you can hurry up and finish the application, you will not get interviewed.

2) Tell us stories about how your actions match your beliefs and values. For example, if I say I value health and fitness, you don't know if I'm telling you the truth or if I'm just telling you what sounds good. But, if I tell you things I've done, I can illustrate my values of health and fitness with proof. For example, I go to the gym 4 days per week, I've done 6 triathlons, including an Ironman, and I can swim 3000 meters in one hour. My examples of things I've done prove that my actions match my values system.

3) Be vulnerable and honest. We take very detailed notes during the interview process, and we conduct extensive background checks. If the stories you tell about yourself don't match what your references say, we will not hire you. We'd rather hire a C student who is honest about being a C student than someone who is a C student but tries to pass themselves off as an A student. Remember, this is an entry-level job. We're not looking for perfect. We're looking for an excellent cultural fit.

title: Remote InHouse Video Editor & Footage Logger
description:
Atomic Trips is looking for a full-time Video Logger + Assistant Video Editor to help turn large amounts of travel footage into organized, story-driven rough edits.



You'll use our creative briefs, shot sheets, trip information, and raw footage to understand the story we're telling, identify the strongest moments, and build the first version of the edit.



Our founder will then open the project, make the final creative decisions, polish the edit, and publish it.



What You’ll Do



Review raw travel footage



Work from detailed shot sheets and creative briefs



Identify which clips match planned shots and story moments



Connect related clips that belong together



Notice when planned shots or story pieces are missing



Help identify what footage can fill those gaps



Log and organize clips by person, location, activity, scene, and story beat



Identify strong dialogue, emotional moments, funny moments, reactions, B-roll, and important details



Pull the strongest selects



Build rough edits from the organized footage



Make revisions based on feedback



Keep projects organized and easy for our founder to continue editing



The Most Important Part



This role requires more than simply watching footage.



You will need to learn our trips, team, travelers, recurring locations, and storytelling style well enough to understand what is happening even when our founder is not there to explain every clip.



Sometimes you will need to piece together the story by combining:



Shot Sheet + Trip Context + People Involved + Raw Footage



We are looking for someone who can think through the footage and help complete the story, not just label files.



Our Workflow



Shot Sheet + Brief → Review Footage → Log & Match Clips → Identify Gaps → Pull Selects → Rough Edit → Founder Finishes Final Cut



Software



We primarily work in CapCut Desktop.



Projects must remain editable so our founder can open your work and continue editing.



What We’re Looking For



You should be:



Extremely organized



Detail-oriented



Good at following a story across many clips



Comfortable reviewing hours of footage



Able to understand creative direction without constant supervision



Strong at recognizing emotional and important story moments

Reliable and consistent



Comfortable learning the people and recurring elements of our trips

$5–$10 USD/hour depending on experience and skill level



This is intended to be a long-term position.



Requirements



A computer capable of video editing



Reliable high-speed internet



Enough storage for large video files



CapCut Desktop



Strong English communication



Reliable full-time availability



How to Apply



Please send:



A short introduction



Your video editing experience



2–3 examples of your work



Your experience with CapCut Desktop



Your computer specifications



Your internet speed

title: QuickBooks cleanup project - 2024 to Sep 2026 - paid on delivery - Wise only
description:
We are hiring two bookkeepers for a fixed project. Not a monthly job. A U.S. California LLC, husband-and-wife operators. The file is behind. You will upload and categorize bank and credit card transactions from statements, then reconcile month by month in QuickBooks.



The work is 33 months: all of 2024, all of 2025, and January through September 2026. You will not do all of it. We are splitting it.



One person takes 2024. One person takes 2025 plus January–September 2026. You work in your own copy or your own period. You do not both edit the live file. We merge after each year reconciles. Order still matters for the final reports: 2024 and 2025 financial statements go to the tax preparer. The January–September 2026 year-to-date profit and loss goes to the property manager.  or breakdown reports, document the facts, and promptly notify the appropriate manager.

ROLE AUTHORITY

You will organize information and coordinate approved actions. Management handles final renter approval, policy exceptions, refunds, disputed charges, insurance decisions, termination, and vehicle recovery. Local staff perform physical vehicle inspections and handovers.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with the subject line “SBR Operations VA.” Include:

- CapCut

- DaVinci Resolve

- or another professional editing platform



### Social Media Content Creation



- Help develop visually engaging content for ProSnap Booth's Instagram, TikTok and other social channels.

- Turn completed events into marketing opportunities rather than simply posting photos.

- Create content designed to capture attention and demonstrate the experience of using a photo booth.

- Develop content that appeals to brides, wedding planners, venues, corporate event professionals and other target customers.

The goal is not simply to "post consistently."



The goal is to create content that makes potential customers stop, watch, understand the experience and want to learn more.



### Branding & Creative Direction



- Help maintain a consistent ProSnap Booth visual identity.

- Follow brand fonts, colors, logos and design standards.

- Help improve the visual consistency of social-media pages.

- Identify when designs feel outdated, inconsistent or off-brand.

A strong eye for branding and visual storytelling is extremely important.



### Social Media Management

- Schedule approved posts.

- Keep content ahead of schedule when possible.

- Maintain organized folders for photos, video footage, final content and reusable creative assets.

- Track what content has already been posted.

- Avoid excessive repetition.

- Help maintain a consistent presence across social channels.

- Monitor basic engagement and identify content that appears to perform particularly well.



### Cold DM & Relationship Outreach



- Assist with Instagram cold-DM campaigns targeting wedding venues, planners and other potential referral partners.

- Follow established outreach scripts and processes.

- Personalize outreach so messages do not feel spammy.

- Complete scheduled follow-ups.

- Monitor responses.

- Distinguish automated replies from genuine responses.

- Keep conversations organized.

- Update CRM information when required.

- Escalate promising partnership opportunities to the owner.



Previous experience with Instagram outreach, lead generation, appointment setting or cold-DM campaigns is strongly preferred.



### Client Design Communication



- Communicate professionally with clients regarding design requests.

- Review information clients submit for their event graphics.

- Request missing logos, colors, wording or design details when necessary.

- Send design proofs when authorized.

- Clearly explain requested revisions.

- Keep communication friendly, professional and easy to understand.

- Avoid making promises regarding pricing, refunds or contractual matters without owner approval.

- Escalate unusual or sensitive client issues when appropriate.



Strong written English is required.



### Digital Marketing Support



Experience with digital marketing is highly preferred.



Additional value includes experience with:



- Meta Ads

-
/Instagram advertising

- Google Ads

- TikTok marketing

- Content strategy

- Social-media analytics

- Landing-page graphics

-
 marketing creative

- Conversion-focused design

- Lead-generation campaigns



Paid advertising experience is a plus but not required.



The candidate should understand that good-looking content is only part of the job. Content should also support lead generation, bookings, brand recognition and customer trust.



## Software & Technical Requirements



Strong experience with:



- Adobe Photoshop

- Canva



Experience with one or more of the following:



- Adobe Premiere Pro

- Final Cut Pro

- CapCut

- DaVinci Resolve



Additional experience with the following is a plus:



- Adobe Illustrator

- Adobe After Effects

- Lightroom

- GoHighLevel

- Meta Business Suite

- Google Drive

- ChatGPT or other AI tools



### Internet Requirements



Because this position involves frequent uploading and downloading of large image and video files, candidates must have:

- Reliable access to a computer capable of handling professional graphic design and video editing

- Sufficient storage for large creative files

Candidates may be asked to provide an internet speed test during the application process.



## Required Skills & Qualities

- Understands basic branding principles

- Produces clean, polished work

- Can follow an existing brand while still bringing fresh creative ideas

- Is highly organized

- Can manage several active projects at once

- Communicates clearly

- Can receive creative feedback without becoming defensive

- Can revise work quickly and accurately

- Checks work carefully before submitting it

- Can work independently

- Can troubleshoot basic technical issues

- Is comfortable learning new systems

- Can manage repetitive responsibilities without sacrificing quality

- Understands the difference between urgency and importance

- Can be trusted with client-facing work

## Portfolio Requirements



A strong portfolio is required.

## What Success Looks Like



Success in this role means:

title: Social Media Manager
description:
ABOUT SKYACCESS

SkyAccess is a marketplace for private jet charter and empty leg flights. Around 40% of private flights fly empty, repositioning with nobody on board. That inventory has always sat behind brokers, phone calls, and quotes you had to ask for. We put it in a search bar: real flights, real prices, booked directly with Part 135 certified operators. We sell whole aircraft, never seats.

We are early and small. There is no content committee, no legacy calendar to inherit, and no agency layer between you and what ships. There is a brand system, a stream of real flight inventory that changes daily, and a lot of room.

What we believe: no one else should decide what is possible for you. We show people what is already there. The jets were just the first door.



THE ROLE

You start your day inside the feed. You are studying what is actually performing right now: the carousel that got 40,000 saves, the thread that got quoted 300 times, the hook that made someone stop scrolling. Not just in aviation. In luxury travel, in real estate, in watches, in finance, in whatever corner of the internet is currently teaching people how to hold attention. You pull those posts apart until you can explain exactly why they worked, then you rebuild that structure around SkyAccess.

Then you make the thing. You write the hook slide, the eight slides after it, and the caption. You design every slide yourself in our brand system so it looks like SkyAccess and not like a template. On X you do the same work in a different shape: threads, image posts, and screenshots built to be quoted. Something goes live on both accounts most days.

The hard part is not the making. It is the honesty afterward. You will publish things you were sure would work that will do nothing, and you will need to look at the saves, shares, and profile visits, decide what actually caused the miss, and change the format instead of defending it. Volume plus judgment is the whole job. People who need two weeks and three approvals to ship one post will find this uncomfortable.

You will work directly with the founder. When you see a format working on Tuesday, you can have our version of it live on Wednesday. That speed is the reason this role exists.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

Format research and intelligence

Maintain a living swipe file of high performing carousels, threads, and image posts, organized by what makes them work: hook type, slide count, pacing, contrast, and payoff.

Run a weekly teardown of three to five standout posts and turn each into a format we can actually test, with a clear reason it should transfer to our audience.

Track what is changing on both platforms: what the algorithm is rewarding, what is getting throttled, what formats are getting tired.

Bring formats from outside aviation. Most of our best ideas will not come from other jet accounts.



Instagram

Write and design carousels end to end: cover hook, slide copy, sequencing, final CTA slide, and caption.

Turn live flight inventory, including weekly empty leg drops, into posts people save and send to a friend.

Own the hook. The first slide decides whether the other nine get seen, and you will write ten versions before picking one.

Build captions that carry search terms and route names naturally, and drive comment based CTAs.



X

Adapt carousel thinking into the formats X actually rewards: threads, standalone image posts, and quotable one liners.

Repurpose strong Instagram content into X native versions rather than cross posting the same file.

Post consistently enough to build a recognizable voice on the account, not just occasional bursts.



Design and brand craft

Build every slide yourself in Canva or Figma inside the SkyAccess system: Tucson Red, Simple Tan, True Black, Inter, photography led.

Hold the line on restraint. Our posts should look like a brand with a point of view, not a stock template with text on top.

Grow the component library over time so recurring formats get faster to produce without getting stale.



Measurement

Report weekly on saves, shares, profile visits, follows, and comment volume, and say plainly what you are repeating and what you are retiring.

Run deliberate tests: same content, different hook, different slide count, different opening image.

Kill formats that stop working, including ones you invented.



WHO YOU ARE

You are the person who screenshots a post that stopped you mid scroll and immediately starts figuring out why it worked. You probably already have a folder of them. You care more about whether something performs than whether it was your idea.



Format obsessed. You can look at a post that did huge numbers and explain the mechanics behind it: what the hook promised, where the tension sat, why slide four made people swipe again. This is the one trait that cannot be trained.



You ship. You would rather publish five good posts this week than one perfect one next month, because you know the fifth one teaches you something the first four could not.



You have taste. Your work looks considered. You know what to leave out, you respect a grid, and you can tell the difference between clean and empty.

You write short. You can get a full idea into six words on a slide and make those six words feel inevitable.



You are unsentimental about your own work. A flop is information. You go find the reason, adjust, and post again.



You are self directed. Nobody is going to hand you a content calendar. You build it, defend it, and change it when the data says to.



You are genuinely curious about the subject. Routes, aircraft types, why a Miami to Aspen leg comes back empty. The people who follow us can tell when the person posting actually finds this interesting.



Backgrounds we are open to: you may have grown your own account to a real following, ghostwritten threads for a founder, run a meme or niche interest page, designed thumbnails and packaging for a YouTube channel, made carousels for an e-commerce or creator led brand, laid out a newsletter, or done social for a restaurant group, a watch dealer, or a real estate team. None of that is aviation and none of it needs to be. If your work is good, we want to see it.



REQUIREMENTS

A portfolio of social content you personally made, with the numbers attached. We want to see the posts and what they did.

You can design in Canva or Figma well enough to take a slide from blank to finished without a designer.

You can write a hook, and you can show us ten different versions of one.

You understand how Instagram and X differ in what they reward, and you can explain why a format that works on one may not transfer to the other.

You are comfortable being measured on output and performance, and comfortable working in public where every result is visible.



BONUS

You have grown an account from near zero to a real, engaged audience and can walk us through how.

You have written threads that traveled, for yourself or for someone else.

You have worked in a category where the buyer is high net worth: travel, real estate, watches, cars, hospitality, or finance.

You can cut short form video as well as design static content.

You have run paid amplification on organic content that was already performing.

You have built and maintained a component or template system that made a team faster.



If you are already the person your friends send posts to and ask why is this getting so many views, this is your job.

title: Quickbooks Bookkeeper
description:
SkyAccess is the leading marketplace for empty-leg private jet flights, connecting travelers to 150,000+ verified empty-leg flights worldwide through certified operators with no membership fees required. Trusted by 100,000+ travelers, SkyAccess makes booking a private jet as simple and transparent as booking any other flight, often at a fraction of typical charter cost. 



At SkyAccess, you'll help redefine how people experience private aviation making it more accessible, transparent, and surprisingly affordable. We're a fast-growing team building the go-to marketplace for empty-leg flights, backed by real demand from a rapidly expanding travel base. Here, your work has a direct impact: every feature you ship, deal you close, or campaign you run helps more travelers discover a smarter way to fly.



*Position Overview



Owns QuickBooks Online end to end and keeps our books reconciled and accurate. SkyAccess sells private jet charters: every trip has a customer payment in and an operator payout out, moving through multiple sources.



*Key Responsibilities:

Own QuickBooks Online: chart of accounts, journal entries, classifications, month-end close.

Recognise revenue on the departure date. Hold customer money in deferred revenue until the flight flies, then release it and book the matching operator cost in the same month.

Reconcile revenue and cost of sales in QuickBooks against HubSpot deal records every month, trip by trip, and write up every exception that will not tie out.

Reconcile all bank and payment accounts monthly.

Find and correct cut-off errors, duplicate postings and misclassifications before they reach the P&L.

Keep a documented month-end checklist and a clean audit trail: every correcting entry numbered, dated and explained.

Deliver the monthly P&L and balance sheet, and explain the variances.





*Required Qualifications:

3+ years full-cycle bookkeeping, 2+ of them as the primary owner of a QuickBooks Online file.

Can write and post a journal entry from first principles and explain both sides of it.

Strong on accrual accounting: deferred revenue, prepaids, accruals, cut-off.

Has reconciled high-volume payment processors; hundreds of transactions a month.

Spreadsheet-fluent: can take two exports and tie them out without being told how.

Written English is clear enough to explain a variance to a non-accountant.

Reliable overlap with US Pacific business hours.

Finds the error and raises it. This is not a data-entry seat.



*Preferred Qualifications:

QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor certification.

CPA, CMA, or an accounting degree.

Marketplace, travel or logistics experience, where revenue and cost pair per transaction.

HubSpot exposure.
